preconditions: The phone has internet access and the thermostat is in pairing mode. A 2.4 GHz network is available, and its correct password is known.
steps: Start pairing in the Android app.
Select the 2.4 GHz network and enter an incorrect password.
Submit the credentials and observe the app and thermostat.
expected: Pairing does not complete, and the app reports that the network credentials are invalid or the thermostat could not connect. The app allows the password to be corrected and retried.

title: Enable frost protection for a zone
preconditions: A thermostat is assigned to an active zone and local controls are available.
steps: Select frost protection for the zone using the thermostat controls.
Check the displayed target or frost protection indicator.
Check that the setting is shown for the selected zone.
expected: Frost protection is active for the selected zone with a target of 5 degrees. The thermostat does not apply the setting to other zones.

title: Switch to the previous month
preconditions: The app is signed in and the home has energy data for at least two consecutive months.
steps: Open the energy reports.
Select the previous month using the report period controls.
Check the report heading and displayed data.
expected: The heading identifies the previous month and the displayed report data updates to that month.

title: Check boiler fault indication for one zone
preconditions: A thermostat is assigned to a zone and controls a boiler. A safe test method is available to make the boiler report a fault.
steps: Cause the boiler to report a fault using the approved test method.
Check the thermostat display for the boiler error.
Check that the fault is associated with the selected zone.
expected: The thermostat displays E-312 when the boiler reports a fault. The indication is shown on the affected zone and does not misidentify another zone.

title: Check away mode after app restart
preconditions: The iOS app is signed in and away mode is active for a home with internet access.
steps: Close the iOS app completely.
Reopen the app and select the home.
Check away mode status and target.
expected: The app shows the current away mode status and target from the home, without switching the mode off or showing stale settings.

title: Recover from app interruption during pairing
preconditions: The thermostat is in pairing mode and the Android app is signed in. A 2.4 GHz network is available.
steps: Start pairing and enter valid network details.
Send the app to the background during setup for at least 30 seconds.
Return to the app and follow its recovery or retry prompt.
expected: The app resumes the pairing flow or clearly offers a restart without creating a duplicate thermostat. Pairing completes after the user continues.

title: Handle loss of cloud access during pairing
preconditions: The iOS app is installed and the user is signed in. A 2.4 GHz network is available, and cloud access can be interrupted during the pairing attempt.
steps: Start pairing and enter valid network details.
Interrupt internet access before pairing completes.
Wait for the app to report the result.
Restore internet access and retry if prompted.
expected: The app does not claim cloud-backed pairing is complete while the cloud is unreachable. The thermostat shows E-110 when it cannot reach the Dormouse cloud, and the app offers a clear retry path.

title: Check report consistency after reopening app
preconditions: A monthly report is available and the Android app is signed in.
steps: Open a monthly report and note its period and values.
Close the app completely.
Reopen the app and open the same report.
expected: The same month and consistent report values are shown after reopening the app.

title: Handle phone Wi-Fi loss during pairing
preconditions: The thermostat is in pairing mode and the app is signed in. A 2.4 GHz network is available, and Android Wi-Fi can be disabled during the test.
steps: Start pairing in the app and proceed until network transfer begins.
Disable Wi-Fi on the Android phone.
Observe the app, re-enable Wi-Fi, and use the retry option.
expected: The app reports that the phone connection was interrupted and does not claim pairing succeeded. After Wi-Fi is restored, the user can retry and complete pairing.

title: Use frost protection during away mode
preconditions: The iOS app is signed in, a thermostat is paired, and away mode is active or can be enabled.
steps: Set the away target to 5 degrees.
Enable away mode.
Check the app target and thermostat display.
expected: The app and thermostat show a target of 5 degrees. The heating control does not use a target below the frost-protection minimum.

title: Operate heating using keyboard only
preconditions: The user is signed in to the web dashboard on a desktop browser. The browser supports keyboard navigation and the thermostat is online.
steps: Reload the heating page and do not use a mouse.
Use Tab and arrow keys to reach the zone target control.
Change the target to 19.5 degrees and save using the keyboard.
Navigate to the boost control and inspect its focused state without activating it.
expected: All heating controls can be reached and operated using the keyboard, with a visible focus indicator. The target is saved as 19.5 degrees and the boost control's purpose and state are accessible.

title: Check report after app update
preconditions: The Android app can be updated from a prior version. A monthly report is available and the account is signed in.
steps: Record the period and values of an available report.
Update the Android app to the test version.
Open the same month's report.
expected: The report remains accessible after the update and shows the correct period and consistent data.

title: Keep household data current after reconnecting
preconditions: The owner and a member can access the household from separate devices. Network access can be interrupted on the member's Android device.
steps: Open household sharing on the member's device.
Disconnect the member device from the network.
Have the owner remove the member, then reconnect the member device.
Refresh household sharing.
expected: The removed member's app updates to show that access has ended. It does not continue to provide usable access based on stale cached membership.

title: Verify zone names with VoiceOver
preconditions: The iOS app is signed in and the home has at least two named zones. VoiceOver is enabled on the iPhone.
steps: Navigate to the home zone list using VoiceOver.
Move focus through each zone entry.
Open one zone and navigate its main controls.
expected: VoiceOver announces each zone name and the purpose and state of its controls. Focus order follows the visible interface without skipping zone controls.

title: Update while the boiler is not responding
preconditions: The thermostat is online, an update is available, and the boiler is not responding, shown as E-305.
steps: Confirm E-305 is visible on the thermostat.
Attempt to start the firmware update.
Inspect the displayed status and boiler control state.
expected: The thermostat does not misrepresent the boiler as responding. The update is handled safely and E-305 remains visible until the boiler issue is resolved.

title: Enable away mode manually
preconditions: The iOS app is installed and signed in as a household member. The home has a paired thermostat and heating is on.
steps: Open the home controls in the iOS app.
Turn on away mode.
Check the app status and thermostat target.
expected: The app shows away mode as on. The thermostat applies the configured away target and the boiler follows that target.

title: Member views firmware status
preconditions: The home owner has shared the home with a household member, and the member is signed in to the iOS app. An update is available.
steps: Sign in as the household member on the iOS app.
Open the thermostat details and check firmware status.
Compare the displayed device identity and status with the owner's view.
expected: The member can see accurate firmware status for the shared thermostat. The app does not expose owner-only controls if the member's permissions do not allow them.

title: Log in with the new password after a password reset
preconditions: A Dormouse account whose password has just been changed using the emailed link. The app is installed and logged out.
steps: Open the Dormouse app.
Enter the account's email address and the new password.
Tap Log in.
Log out, then try to log in again with the old password.
expected: The new password opens the home screen with the account's thermostats. The old password is refused with 'Incorrect email or password'.

title: View report with no recorded energy
preconditions: The app is signed in to a home with no energy data for a selected month.
steps: Open the energy reports.
Select the month with no recorded data.
Review the report content and any empty-state message.
expected: The app clearly indicates that no report data is available for that month and does not show misleading values or a crash.

title: Check rapid month changes
preconditions: Reports are available for at least three months. The Android app is signed in.
steps: Open the energy reports.
Change the selected month several times quickly.
Wait for loading to finish and check the final selected month.
expected: The final report matches the last selected month. Late responses for earlier selections do not replace the final report or mix data.

title: Check report after signing out
preconditions: The app is signed in and a monthly report has been viewed. The account can be signed out.
steps: Sign out of the Android app.
Use the app's back navigation or reopen it.
Attempt to access the previously viewed report.
expected: The report is not accessible while signed out, and the app prompts for sign-in without exposing report data.

title: Check frost protection target
preconditions: The thermostat is powered on and frost protection can be selected from its local controls. The boiler is responsive.
steps: Use the thermostat controls to select frost protection.
Read the target shown on the display.
expected: Frost protection is active and the displayed target is 5 degrees.

title: Copy a schedule to other days
preconditions: The iOS app is signed in and a complete schedule exists for one day. The thermostat is online.
steps: Open the day with the schedule to copy.
Use the app's copy or repeat option for two other days.
Save the changes.
Inspect all three days.
expected: The selected days show identical periods and targets. Days not selected for copying remain unchanged.

title: Check report access for a household member
preconditions: A household owner has shared the home with a member account. The member is signed in and has permission to view the home dashboard.
steps: Sign in as the household member.
Open the shared home's Energy reports page.
expected: The member can view the shared home's report if report access is included in their permissions, and the dashboard identifies the correct home. If access is restricted, a clear access message is shown and report data is not exposed.

title: Change a zone target without colour cues
preconditions: An online zone exists. Android colour correction or a greyscale display setting is enabled.
steps: Open the zone's heating controls.
Change the target by 0.5 degrees.
Check the selected value and save or confirm if required.
expected: The current target and selected control state remain distinguishable without colour alone. The app shows the new numerical target clearly.

title: Check sharing at browser zoom
preconditions: An owner is signed in to the web dashboard. The browser supports page zoom.
steps: Set browser zoom to 200 percent.
Open household sharing settings.
Use the invite form and review the member list.
expected: Text and controls remain usable at 200 percent zoom without content being clipped or requiring horizontal scrolling for ordinary actions. The owner can complete the invitation.

title: Check schedule at midnight boundary
preconditions: An enabled schedule has periods around midnight on consecutive days. A test environment or clock control can advance across midnight.
steps: Set the final period of one day and first period of the next day to different targets.
Advance the clock across midnight.
Refresh the dashboard.
Check the active period and target.
expected: The next day's schedule becomes active at the correct time. The dashboard shows the correct day, period and target without a gap or unintended overlap.

title: Prevent away mode when another resident remains home
preconditions: The owner and one household member have iPhones with geofencing enabled and permission set to Always. Both devices are registered to the same home, and the household member remains inside the geofence.
steps: Take the owner's iPhone outside the home geofence.
Wait longer than the configured departure delay.
Check the home's mode in the iOS app.
expected: Away mode does not activate while the household member remains home. The app continues to show the home as occupied.

title: Set a zone to the maximum target
preconditions: A thermostat is assigned to an active zone and is ready for local control.
steps: Turn the dial up until the target reaches 30 degrees.
Press the dial to confirm the target.
Turn the dial up once more.
expected: The target can be set to 30 degrees and does not go above it. The display remains clear and responsive at the upper limit.

title: Handle Wi-Fi loss during update
preconditions: An update is available and the thermostat is connected to Wi-Fi. The test environment can interrupt Wi-Fi and restore it.
steps: Interrupt the thermostat's Wi-Fi during the update process.
Check the thermostat display and iOS app for status.
Restore Wi-Fi and allow the thermostat time to reconnect.
expected: The app and display report the loss of connectivity without presenting a false completion. After Wi-Fi returns, the thermostat reconnects and reports whether the update completed or needs to be retried.

title: Pair after scanning thermostat QR code
preconditions: The Android app is signed in to an owner account with an available home. The thermostat is in pairing mode, and the phone is connected to a working 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi network.
steps: Open the app and choose to add a thermostat.
Scan the QR code on the thermostat when prompted.
Confirm the displayed thermostat identity and select the home.
Wait for setup to finish.
expected: The app confirms pairing, and the thermostat appears in the selected home with its current status. No second thermostat entry is created.

title: Check report with offline Android device
preconditions: A monthly report has been opened successfully at least once. The Android device supports airplane mode.
steps: Enable airplane mode.
Open the energy reports or revisit the previously viewed report.
Disable airplane mode and retry loading the report.
expected: The app clearly distinguishes unavailable online data from a loaded report. After connectivity returns, retry loads the current report.

title: Recover when the network is not found
preconditions: The iOS app is installed and the user is signed in. The thermostat is in pairing mode, but the selected 2.4 GHz network is unavailable to it.
steps: Start pairing and select the unavailable network.
Continue with the network details.
Wait for the connection attempt to fail.
Restore a suitable 2.4 GHz network and retry pairing.
expected: The failed attempt reports E-101 on the thermostat and does not add it as paired in the app. After the network is restored, pairing can complete successfully.

title: View a previous monthly report
preconditions: The iOS app is signed in and the account has reports for at least two completed months.
steps: Open Energy reports.
Select the previous month.
Review the displayed report period and data.
expected: The selected previous month is shown, with its own report data rather than the current month's data.

title: Discard unsaved schedule changes
preconditions: The thermostat has a saved schedule and supports editing. A harmless change can be made without saving.
steps: Open a scheduled period and change its target temperature.
Exit the editor without choosing Save.
Reopen the same period.
expected: The thermostat discards the unsaved change and shows the original saved target.

title: Check schedule layout at high zoom
preconditions: An owner is signed in to the web dashboard on a supported browser. A zone has an existing schedule.
steps: Set browser zoom to 200 percent.
Open the schedule and review all period controls and values.
Edit and save one period at this zoom level.
expected: Schedule content and controls remain readable and usable without overlapping or being clipped. The user can complete the edit and see the saved result.

title: Respect notification preferences
preconditions: A user account is signed in and can change notification preferences. A test condition or approved simulator can generate an event type whose notifications can be enabled or disabled.
steps: Disable notifications for the selected event type.
Trigger that event using the approved test method.
Check the dashboard notification list.
Enable the event type and trigger it again.
expected: The disabled event does not create a dashboard notification where the preference applies. After the preference is enabled, the next event creates a notification.

title: Avoid losing edits after a network interruption
preconditions: An owner is signed in and can edit an online thermostat's schedule. A safe test method is available to interrupt the browser's network connection.
steps: Change a schedule period without saving.
Interrupt the browser network connection and attempt to save.
Restore the connection and inspect the editor.
expected: The dashboard reports the connection problem and does not falsely confirm a save. The unsaved change is retained where possible or the dashboard clearly indicates that it must be re-entered.

title: Check away mode with active schedule
preconditions: A schedule is configured on the thermostat and away mode is off. The Android app is connected.
steps: Note the current scheduled target temperature.
Turn on away mode in the app.
Check the thermostat target and schedule status.
expected: While away mode is active, the thermostat uses the away temperature instead of the scheduled target. The saved schedule remains intact.

title: Remove a thermostat from a zone
preconditions: The Android app is signed in as the home owner. A zone contains one paired thermostat.
steps: Open the zone and choose its thermostat settings.
Select Remove from zone and confirm.
Return to the zone list.
expected: The thermostat is removed from the zone and is available to assign elsewhere. The zone remains available if empty.

title: Invite a member at the limit boundary
preconditions: The owner is signed in and the home has seven members, not counting the owner. A valid email address is available for one more person.
steps: Invite the eighth member.
Accept the invitation from the invitee account.
Check the household member list.
expected: The invitation can be sent and accepted. The home shows eight members and does not allow a further member to be added.

title: Verify notifications are disabled
preconditions: Notifications for the Dormouse iOS app are disabled in iOS settings. An update can be completed in the test environment.
steps: Confirm Dormouse notifications are disabled in iOS settings.
Allow the update to complete.
Open the app and check the firmware status.
expected: No Dormouse push notification appears while notifications are disabled. The app still shows the correct update result when opened.

title: Check notification after device restart
preconditions: The iOS app is signed in and notifications are allowed. A paired thermostat can generate a test notification, and the iPhone can be restarted.
steps: Restart the iPhone and unlock it.
Generate a test notification after the phone reconnects to the network.
Check the iPhone notification centre.
expected: The app can receive a new notification after restart. The notification is not lost solely because the iPhone was restarted.

title: Check half-degree target increments
preconditions: The thermostat is powered on and showing the target temperature control. The boiler is operating normally.
steps: Turn the dial one step clockwise.
Read the target shown on the display.
Turn the dial one step anticlockwise.
expected: The target changes by exactly 0.5 degrees per dial step. Turning back restores the original target.

title: Recover after update error E-510
preconditions: The thermostat can be placed in a controlled test setup that produces E-510 during an update. The boiler is safe to leave under its normal control.
steps: Start the firmware update on the thermostat.
Cause the test setup to produce E-510.
Follow the on-screen recovery option and check the displayed firmware version.
expected: The thermostat displays E-510 and does not claim the update succeeded. It remains usable with valid firmware or offers a clear safe recovery path.

title: Pair with reduced motion enabled
preconditions: The iOS app is installed and the user is signed in. Reduce Motion is enabled in iOS, and the thermostat is ready to pair.
steps: Start the add-thermostat flow.
Complete the pairing steps while observing screen transitions and progress feedback.
Wait for pairing to finish.
expected: The pairing flow remains usable with reduced motion enabled, and progress is conveyed without depending on animation alone. Pairing completes successfully.

title: Check password minimum length boundary
preconditions: The tester is signed out and has an unused email address. The password requirements are visible during registration.
steps: Enter the unused email address and a password one character shorter than the stated minimum.
Submit the form.
If rejected, add one character to meet the minimum and submit again.
expected: The too-short password is rejected with a clear explanation. A password that meets the stated minimum is accepted if it meets all other displayed rules.

title: Boost expires after one hour
preconditions: The thermostat is online and the iOS app is signed in. Boost can be started and allowed to run without interruption.
steps: Start boost in the iOS app.
Leave boost active for one hour.
Check the app and thermostat after the hour has elapsed.
expected: Boost ends after one hour and the thermostat resumes normal heating control.

title: Sign out and prevent access to account content
preconditions: The tester is signed in to a Dormouse account in the iOS app.
steps: Open the account or profile area.
Choose sign out and confirm if prompted.
Use the app's back navigation to try to return to account content.
expected: The app signs out and requires authentication before showing protected account content.

title: Edit a scheduled target temperature
preconditions: The iOS app is signed in and a schedule period already exists for the selected day. The thermostat is online.
steps: Open the existing schedule period.
Change its target temperature to 21.5 degrees.
Save the change.
Reopen the period.
expected: The period shows 21.5 degrees after saving and reopening. The updated target is sent to the thermostat.

title: Reject an incorrect two-step verification code
preconditions: A Dormouse account has two-step verification enabled. The tester can reach the verification-code prompt but will enter an incorrect code.
steps: Enter the correct account credentials.
Enter an incorrect verification code.
Submit the code.
expected: Sign-in is denied and the app identifies the code as invalid without revealing account secrets. The tester remains at the verification step.

title: Power interruption during firmware installation
preconditions: An update is installing on the thermostat. A controlled test setup can interrupt and restore mains power without creating a boiler hazard.
steps: Start the update and wait until installation begins.
Interrupt mains power briefly, then restore it.
Wait for restart and inspect the firmware status and controls.
expected: The thermostat recovers to working firmware or enters a clear recovery state. It does not issue uncontrolled boiler commands or claim success with an invalid installation.

title: Reject account creation with a registered email
preconditions: An account already exists for an email address available to the tester, and the app is open on account creation.
steps: Enter the registered email address and valid values in the other fields.
Submit the form.
expected: The app does not create a duplicate account and explains that the email is already registered or offers an appropriate sign-in route.

title: View report with no internet connection
preconditions: The iOS app is signed in and has previously loaded a monthly report.
steps: Open a monthly report while online.
Disable the phone's internet connection.
Reopen or refresh the report.
expected: The app either shows clearly identified cached report data or explains that it cannot load the report offline. It does not show an indefinite spinner or misleading empty data.

title: Start a one-hour boost for a zone
preconditions: A zone with an online thermostat exists and boost is not active. The Android app is signed in to the home.
steps: Open the zone's heating controls.
Select Boost and confirm if prompted.
Check the zone status and the thermostat display.
expected: Boost is shown as active for the selected zone, and its thermostat indicates boost. The app shows that the boost lasts one hour.

title: Check dial navigation does not obscure sensor readings
preconditions: The thermostat is powered and both sensors are functioning. Its dial can be turned and pressed to navigate menus.
steps: Wake the display and note both readings.
Turn the dial to open a menu.
Press the dial to select a menu item, then return to the normal screen.
expected: Menu navigation works without changing the sensor readings unintentionally. Both readings are visible again on the normal screen.

title: Pair while VoiceOver is enabled
preconditions: The iOS app is installed and the user is signed in. VoiceOver is enabled, and the thermostat and iPhone can use a suitable 2.4 GHz network.
steps: Start the add-thermostat flow using VoiceOver.
Navigate the screens and enter the Wi-Fi password.
Activate the pairing action using VoiceOver.
Follow the spoken status until pairing finishes.
expected: All pairing controls, fields, instructions, and status messages have meaningful VoiceOver labels and are reachable in a logical order. Pairing succeeds without requiring sighted-only interaction.

title: Pair near the edge of Wi-Fi coverage
preconditions: The iOS app is installed and the user is signed in. The thermostat is at the edge of reliable 2.4 GHz coverage and is ready to pair.
steps: Start pairing in the app.
Enter valid Wi-Fi details and begin the connection attempt.
Observe the app and thermostat status.
Move the thermostat into reliable coverage and retry if pairing fails.
expected: The app reports pairing failure clearly if the connection is insufficient and does not claim success prematurely. In reliable coverage, a retry can pair successfully.

title: Request another two-step verification code
preconditions: A Dormouse account has two-step verification enabled and the tester can receive verification codes. The tester is at the code-entry step.
steps: Choose the option to resend or request another code.
Retrieve the newest code.
Enter it and submit.
expected: A new code is issued without signing in prematurely. The newest valid code completes sign-in, while an invalid or expired code is not accepted.

title: Firmware update installs overnight and keeps the schedule
preconditions: A thermostat one firmware version behind, with a schedule set, and the test update server offering the new version.
steps: Move the test clock to 01:55.
Wait for the update window between 02:00 and 04:00.
After the restart, check the version number and the schedule.
expected: The new version installs between 02:00 and 04:00, the thermostat restarts by itself, and the schedule is unchanged.

title: Verify schedule times after time-zone change
preconditions: A thermostat has a saved schedule with identifiable start times. The Android phone allows changing its time zone.
steps: Record the schedule's displayed times.
Change the phone's time zone and reopen the schedule.
Compare the displayed times with the recorded values.
expected: The app handles the time-zone change consistently and clearly; it does not silently shift scheduled times. Any intended time-zone conversion is reflected accurately in the displayed schedule.

title: Open an expired invitation link
preconditions: An invitation link is expired or has been revoked. The invitee can open the link on an iPhone.
steps: Open the expired or revoked invitation link.
Check the message shown by the app or web view.
Return to the app and check the home list.
expected: The invitee is told that the invitation is no longer valid and is not added to the home.

title: Set different schedules by weekday
preconditions: The iOS app is signed in and paired with an online thermostat. No schedule changes are in progress.
steps: Open the weekly schedule.
Set Monday's first period to 19 degrees at 06:30.
Set Tuesday's first period to 20 degrees at 07:30.
Save and inspect both days.
expected: Monday and Tuesday retain their separate start times and targets after saving. Changing one day does not alter the other.

title: Update with Wi-Fi network unavailable
preconditions: An update is available in the thermostat interface, but its paired 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi network is turned off.
steps: Open the update option on the thermostat.
Attempt to check or download the update.
Observe the display for a connection message.
expected: The thermostat reports E-101 or an equally clear network-unavailable status. It does not show false progress or begin installing unavailable firmware.

title: Receive boiler not responding notification
preconditions: The iOS app is signed in and notifications are allowed. A paired thermostat is connected to a test setup that can make the boiler stop responding.
steps: Make the boiler stop responding to the thermostat.
Wait for the app to receive the status.
Check the iPhone notification centre.
expected: The app sends a notification that the boiler is not responding and identifies the affected thermostat or zone. It does not describe the issue as a boiler-reported fault unless one was reported.

title: Retry update after correcting Wi-Fi credentials
preconditions: An available update has failed because the thermostat cannot connect to its configured Wi-Fi. The correct 2.4 GHz network is available and the Android app is signed in.
steps: Restore the correct Wi-Fi connection for the thermostat.
Confirm in the app that the thermostat is online.
Retry or wait for the firmware update attempt.
expected: The app shows the thermostat online and the update can proceed. The update status advances without retaining a stale network failure.

title: Create the maximum six daily periods
preconditions: The iOS app is signed in and the selected day has fewer than six periods. The thermostat is online.
steps: Open the selected day's schedule.
Add periods until the day has six periods, using valid increasing start times.
Save the schedule.
Reopen the day and count its periods.
expected: The app saves and displays all six periods. Each period retains its configured time and target.

title: Reject an incorrect two-step verification code
preconditions: A verified account has two-step verification enabled and can reach the code entry screen.
steps: Sign in with the correct email and password.
Enter an incorrect verification code.
Submit the code.
expected: The app rejects the code, keeps the account signed out and offers a safe way to try again.

title: Pair using a hidden 2.4 GHz network
preconditions: The iOS app is installed and the user is signed in. A working hidden 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi network is available, and the thermostat is in pairing mode.
steps: Choose to add a thermostat in the app.
Select the option to enter network details manually.
Enter the hidden network name and password.
Follow the pairing instructions.
expected: The app connects the thermostat to the hidden network and confirms pairing. The thermostat appears as online.

title: Check failed firmware update indication
preconditions: The thermostat is powered on and its firmware update process can be safely made to fail using an approved test setup.
steps: Run the approved test that causes a firmware update to fail.
Wait for the update attempt to finish.
Inspect the thermostat display.
expected: The thermostat displays E-510 to indicate that the firmware update failed. It remains usable for local heating control.

title: Use the one-hour heating boost
preconditions: The thermostat is online and the room temperature is below the current target. The dashboard has access to the zone's boost control.
steps: Open the zone's heating controls.
Start the one-hour boost.
Check the boost status and expiry time.
Cancel the boost from the dashboard.
expected: The dashboard shows that boost is active for the selected zone and indicates its one-hour duration. Cancelling it ends the boost and restores normal heating control.

title: Rename a zone
preconditions: The iOS app is signed in as the home owner. The home has at least one zone.
steps: Open the zone settings.
Change the zone name to a new valid name.
Save and reopen the zone list.
expected: The new name is displayed for that zone in the zone list and its detail screen.

title: Recover after cloud access returns
preconditions: The thermostat is powered and unpaired. Cloud access is initially unavailable and can be restored during the test.
steps: Start pairing with valid 2.4 GHz network credentials while cloud access is unavailable.
Observe the resulting error.
Restore cloud access and retry pairing on the thermostat.
expected: The initial attempt indicates the cloud connection problem with E-110. After cloud access returns, a retry can complete pairing without requiring a power cycle.

title: Invite an existing Dormouse account
preconditions: The owner is signed in and has a home with an available member place. The intended invitee already has a Dormouse account using the email address to be invited.
steps: Open household sharing for the home.
Invite the existing account's email address.
On the invitee's iPhone, open the invitation and accept it.
Check the invitee's home list.
expected: The existing account joins the home without creating a duplicate account, and the home appears in its home list.

title: Pair while VoiceOver is enabled and verify setup announcements
preconditions: VoiceOver is enabled on the iPhone. The thermostat is in pairing mode, and a valid 2.4 GHz network is available.
steps: Open thermostat setup in the iOS app and navigate through controls using VoiceOver gestures.
Select the Wi-Fi network, enter its password, and activate the continue control.
Follow the spoken pairing progress and completion announcements.
expected: VoiceOver identifies the setup controls and their current focus, and announces meaningful pairing progress and completion. The user can complete pairing without relying on visual-only instructions.

title: Set a valid zone target temperature
preconditions: The iOS app is signed in with permission to control the home. The home has at least one zone with an online thermostat.
steps: Open the zone's temperature control.
Set the target to a valid value using a half-degree step.
Save the target.
expected: The selected zone shows the chosen target temperature, and the thermostat receives the setting.

title: Check sensor display after changing screen brightness
preconditions: The thermostat is powered and provides a screen brightness control. Live temperature and humidity readings are available.
steps: Note the displayed temperature and humidity.
Use the thermostat controls to set the screen to its lowest brightness.
Check that both readings remain legible, then restore the original brightness.
expected: Changing brightness does not alter the sensor values or hide either reading; both remain legible at the selected brightness.

title: Check password maximum length boundary
preconditions: The tester is signed out and the account registration page is open. The documented maximum password length is available.
steps: Enter a valid email and a password at the documented maximum length that meets the other rules.
Submit the form.
Repeat with a password one character over the documented maximum.
expected: The maximum-length password is handled without truncation or interface failure. The over-limit value is rejected or prevented in accordance with the documented limit, with a clear explanation.

title: Check report access after sharing is removed
preconditions: A member account has previously viewed an owner's report; the owner can remove that member's household access.
steps: Remove the member's access from the owner account.
Open or refresh Energy reports in the member's iOS app.
expected: The member can no longer access the removed household's report. The app explains that access is unavailable and does not continue showing newly fetched private household data.

title: Check transition between schedule periods
preconditions: An enabled schedule has two consecutive periods with different targets, and the thermostat is online. A test environment or clock control can trigger the period transition.
steps: Set the first period to 18 degrees.
Set the next period to 21 degrees.
Advance the clock to the next period.
Refresh the dashboard and check the active target.
expected: At the period boundary, the active target changes from 18 to 21 degrees. The dashboard identifies the new active scheduled target.

title: Recover from an incorrect network name
preconditions: The thermostat is powered and unpaired. A manually entered network name differs from the name of the available 2.4 GHz network by one character.
steps: Open manual network entry during pairing.
Enter the mistyped network name and valid password.
Attempt to connect, then use the retry option.
Enter the exact network name and password.
expected: The first attempt does not connect to a different network or report successful pairing. After correcting the name, the thermostat connects and completes pairing.

title: Deny location permission for geofencing
preconditions: The Android app is signed in and geofencing has not yet been granted location permission.
steps: Attempt to enable geofencing.
Deny the Android location permission request.
Review the app's away mode settings.
expected: The app explains that location permission is needed for geofencing. Geofencing remains off and manual away mode remains available.

title: Check away mode as a household member
preconditions: The iOS app is signed in as a household member, not the owner. The member has access to a shared home with away mode enabled.
steps: Open the shared home controls.
View away status and target.
Try to change away mode.
expected: The member can see the current away status. Any permitted change succeeds and is reflected in the home; if the member lacks permission, the app clearly prevents the change without altering the setting.

title: Reject a target above the maximum
preconditions: An owner is signed in to the web dashboard. A zone has an online thermostat and the target editor permits keyboard input.
steps: Open the zone target editor.
Enter 30.5 degrees.
Attempt to save the target.
expected: The dashboard rejects the out-of-range value or prevents saving it. The saved target remains within the 5 to 30 degrees range.

title: Check dial operation with gloves
preconditions: The thermostat is on a screen that accepts dial input. Suitable thin gloves are available.
steps: Put on thin gloves suitable for household use.
Turn the dial by one small movement.
Press the dial once.
expected: The dial and press control register deliberate inputs while gloved, with visible feedback and no unintended multiple actions.

title: Assign a thermostat to only one zone
preconditions: An owner is signed in to the web dashboard. Two zones exist and one thermostat is assigned to the first zone.
steps: Open the second zone's assignment controls.
Attempt to assign the thermostat already in the first zone.
Save if the dashboard permits the action.
expected: The thermostat is not assigned to both zones at once. The dashboard either prevents the assignment or moves it from the first zone with a clear result.

title: Check zone list at maximum size
preconditions: The iOS app is signed in and the home has four zones with distinct names. iOS display zoom or the app's supported enlarged display setting is enabled.
steps: Open the home zone list.
Scroll through all four zones.
Open the last zone in the list.
expected: All four zones can be reached and selected. Zone labels and selection controls remain visible and do not block one another.

title: Receive a notification when Wi-Fi is not found
preconditions: The Android app is signed in and notifications are enabled. A safe setup can make the paired thermostat report that its configured Wi-Fi network is not found.
steps: Make the configured Wi-Fi network unavailable to the thermostat.
Wait for the thermostat to report the issue.
Check the Android notification shade.
expected: A notification reports that the thermostat cannot find its Wi-Fi network. It identifies the affected thermostat and does not claim that pairing has timed out.

title: Preserve boost state across update
preconditions: The thermostat is paired and an update is available. A one-hour boost can be started in the Android app.
steps: Start a one-hour boost in the app and note its end time.
Allow the overnight update to run, or test in an approved update test environment.
Review the boost status and target after the update.
expected: The app does not show a false boost state or extend the boost beyond its defined duration. The boost status and heating target accurately reflect the product's documented update behaviour.

title: Open a notification while app is in foreground
preconditions: The iOS app is signed in and a paired thermostat can generate a test notification. The app is open in the foreground.
steps: Keep the app open on a screen unrelated to the test event.
Generate a test notification.
Observe how the event is presented and open it if shown.
expected: The event is presented according to the app's notification behaviour without freezing or unexpectedly resetting the app. The user can reach the relevant event details.

title: Use zones with keyboard navigation
preconditions: An owner is signed in to the web dashboard using a keyboard. The home has at least two zones.
steps: Navigate to the zones page using the keyboard only.
Move through zone names and controls using Tab and the arrow keys where supported.
Open a zone and change a target using the keyboard.
expected: All zone controls are reachable and operable without a mouse, with a visible focus indicator. The selected zone and target change are clear.

title: Check schedule editor in landscape
preconditions: The Android phone supports landscape orientation. The user is signed in and can open a thermostat schedule.
steps: Open the schedule editor in portrait.
Rotate the phone to landscape.
Edit a period and save.
expected: The schedule remains legible and usable in landscape, or the app clearly locks orientation. No schedule values are lost during rotation.

title: Check notification delivery for a household member
preconditions: The owner and a household member have Android app access to the same home. Notifications are enabled for the member, and a safe test alert can be generated.
steps: Sign in as the household member.
Generate a test alert for the shared home.
Check the member's notification shade.
Open the alert.
expected: The member receives the alert for the shared home and can open its details. The notification does not reveal information from a home the member cannot access.

title: Check notifications during Focus mode
preconditions: The iOS app is signed in and notifications are allowed. A paired thermostat can generate test notifications, and an iOS Focus mode is configured to silence the app.
steps: Enable the configured Focus mode.
Generate a test notification.
Check the lock screen and notification centre.
Disable Focus and review the notification history.
expected: The notification follows iOS Focus rules and is not presented in a way that bypasses them. If retained by iOS, it is available in the notification centre after the event.

title: Request a password reset for an unknown email
preconditions: The tester has an email address not registered with Dormouse and is signed out.
steps: Open the password reset flow.
Enter the unregistered email address.
Submit the request.
expected: The app displays a privacy-preserving confirmation and does not disclose whether an account exists.

title: Check frost protection is visible at its target
preconditions: Frost protection is enabled on the thermostat.
steps: View the thermostat home screen.
Check the displayed target and frost protection status.
Turn the dial one click and observe the resulting behaviour.
expected: The display shows frost protection at 5 degrees. Any dial interaction follows the thermostat's defined frost protection controls without showing a target below 5 degrees.

title: Retry after a report service error
preconditions: The report service can be made unavailable and then restored. The user is signed in to the web dashboard.
steps: Request a report while the report service is unavailable.
Restore the report service.
Use the dashboard's retry action or request the report again.
expected: The first request reports the failure clearly. After service recovery, the report loads successfully with the requested period identified.

title: Check temperature sensor response to gradual change
preconditions: The thermostat is powered with its temperature sensor connected. A safe, gradual change in room temperature can be made near the thermostat.
steps: Record the displayed room temperature.
Gradually warm the air near the thermostat without touching it.
Wait for the reading to update.
Remove the heat source and observe the reading.
expected: The displayed temperature responds upward to warming and later responds downward as the area cools. The display remains in normal operation throughout.

title: Validate blank registration fields
preconditions: The tester is signed out and the account registration page is open.
steps: Leave the email and password fields empty.
Submit the form.
Review field validation.
expected: The form does not submit and clearly marks both required fields. No account is created.

title: Verify display startup after power-on
preconditions: The thermostat is powered and connected to a working boiler. The display is currently off or the thermostat has just been restarted.
steps: Switch on power to the thermostat.
Observe the display through startup.
Wait until the normal home screen appears.
expected: The display starts without blanking or showing an error, then presents the normal home screen with readable status.

title: Verify Dynamic Type in notification details
preconditions: The iOS app is signed in and a paired thermostat can generate a test notification. Set iOS text size to a large supported Dynamic Type size.
steps: Generate a test notification and open it in the app.
Read the event details at the selected text size.
Move through the screen controls.
expected: Notification details remain readable without clipped text or overlapping controls at the selected size. Relevant actions remain available.

title: Confirm sign-out cancellation keeps the session
preconditions: The tester is signed in and the app asks for confirmation before signing out.
steps: Choose sign out.
Cancel the confirmation prompt.
expected: The prompt closes and the tester remains signed in.

title: Decline an available firmware update
preconditions: The thermostat is online and an update is available. Heating is operating normally.
steps: Open the firmware update prompt on the thermostat.
Choose to install later or decline.
Return to the home screen and check heating status.
expected: The update does not start. The thermostat returns to normal operation and retains its existing firmware and heating settings.

title: Verify sharing does not expose another home's members
preconditions: The owner has two homes with different household members and is signed in to the iOS app. At least one member is not shared between the homes.
steps: Open household sharing for the first home and note its members.
Switch to the second home and open household sharing.
Compare the member lists and home names.
Return to the first home and confirm its list.
expected: Each screen shows only the members and invitations for its selected home; no member data is incorrectly carried over from the other home.

title: Handle cloud failure while enabling away
preconditions: The iOS app is signed in. The test environment can make the Dormouse cloud unreachable while the thermostat remains powered.
steps: Make the Dormouse cloud unreachable.
Try to enable away mode in the app.
Restore cloud access and refresh the home controls.
expected: The app reports that the request could not be confirmed and does not falsely show away mode as applied. After access is restored, the app shows the actual home status.

title: Return a zone from frost protection
preconditions: Frost protection is active for the thermostat's zone. A normal target or schedule is configured for that zone.
steps: Exit frost protection using the thermostat controls.
Check the displayed operating mode.
Check the zone's normal target or schedule state.
expected: Frost protection is no longer active. The zone returns to its configured normal control without changing another zone.

title: Check sensor readings after a dial press
preconditions: The thermostat is powered and displaying live temperature and humidity readings.
steps: Record both displayed readings.
Press the dial once to open the on-device control view.
Return to the sensor view using the dial.
expected: The sensor readings are displayed again on return and remain legible; using the dial does not cause a sensor error.

title: Handle missing network when enabling away mode
preconditions: The Android app is signed in and paired with an online thermostat. The phone can have its network connection disabled.
steps: Disable the phone's Wi-Fi and mobile data.
Turn on away mode in the app.
Restore the phone's network connection and refresh the home controls.
expected: The app clearly indicates if the change could not be sent or is pending. Once connectivity returns, the app and thermostat show a consistent away mode state.

title: Verify two-step challenge on every sign-in
preconditions: An account with two-step verification enabled is available. Use a browser and device already trusted for the account.
steps: Open a private browser window and sign in with the account credentials.
Complete the two-step verification challenge.
Sign out, then sign in again in the same private window.
Complete the challenge again.
expected: A valid two-step code is required for both sign-ins because the private window is not trusted. The dashboard opens only after each challenge is completed.

title: Check access after household removal
preconditions: A second iOS account has previously been a member of a shared home. The owner can remove that member during the test.
steps: Remove the test member from the home using the owner account.
Open the home controls in the removed member's app.
Try to view or change away mode.
expected: The removed member can no longer access or change that home's away settings. The app shows that access has been removed or the home is unavailable.

title: Set different schedules for weekdays and weekends
preconditions: An owner is signed in and has a paired, online thermostat with a configured zone.
steps: Open the zone's schedule page.
Set one period for weekdays and a different period for Saturday and Sunday.
Save, then review each day's schedule.
expected: Weekday periods appear only on the selected weekdays, and weekend periods appear on Saturday and Sunday. The dashboard shows the saved times and temperatures accurately.

title: Check report values use the configured unit
preconditions: The user's account has a configured energy unit and a report with energy values. The unit preference is visible in dashboard settings.
steps: Note the energy unit configured for the account.
Open an energy report with non-zero values.
expected: Energy values are labelled using the account's configured unit consistently throughout the report.

title: Reject a target between allowed steps
preconditions: The thermostat is online and the dashboard target control is available. The control permits keyboard or text entry.
steps: Focus the target temperature control.
Enter 20.3 degrees.
Submit or save the value.
Check the displayed target and any validation message.
expected: The dashboard rejects the value or adjusts it to a valid half-degree step with a clear indication. It does not send 20.3 degrees as the thermostat target.

title: Check screen reader notification labels
preconditions: A signed-in user has notifications available. A screen reader is available on the test system.
steps: Open the notifications view with the screen reader running.
Navigate through the notification list.
Move to a notification action such as mark as read.
expected: The screen reader announces each notification's message and relevant status, and announces controls with understandable names. The notification order is clear when navigated.

title: Check update status for several zones
preconditions: The home has at least two paired thermostats in different zones, and an update is available for them. The iOS app is signed in as the home owner.
steps: Open the home's device or zone list in the iOS app.
Check the firmware status for each thermostat.
Open each thermostat's details and compare the reported versions.
expected: Firmware status and version are shown against the correct thermostat and zone. Updating one thermostat does not incorrectly mark another thermostat as updated.

title: Check screen reader labels in report
preconditions: TalkBack is available on the Android device and a monthly report is available.
steps: Enable TalkBack.
Open the energy reports and move focus through the report.
Listen to the report period, values, chart or summary, and available controls.
expected: TalkBack announces meaningful labels and values in a logical order, including the report period and controls, without relying only on visual chart details.

title: Set a heating target from the dashboard
preconditions: The thermostat is paired, online and assigned to a zone. The user is signed in to the web dashboard with heating controls available.
steps: Open the zone's heating controls.
Set the target temperature to 21 degrees.
Save the change.
Check the dashboard and thermostat display.
expected: The dashboard shows a target of 21 degrees for the selected zone. The thermostat display updates to 21 degrees and the boiler is requested to heat if the measured temperature is below target.

title: Check boost duration countdown
preconditions: Thermostat is paired and the boost function is available. The room and boiler are in normal operating conditions.
steps: Start a one-hour boost using the boost button.
Check the display for boost status and remaining duration, if shown.
Wait until the boost expires.
Check the display and heating status.
expected: The display shows boost as active for the configured hour and then shows it as ended. After expiry, normal thermostat control resumes.

title: E-305 when the boiler stops responding
preconditions: A thermostat wired to the boiler simulator on the test bench, calling for heat.
steps: Switch the boiler simulator off at the wall.
Wait five minutes and read the display.
Switch the simulator back on.
expected: The display shows E-305 within five minutes and the app shows a 'Boiler not responding' alert. Both clear once the boiler answers again.

title: Check disconnected temperature sensor on a zone
preconditions: A thermostat is assigned to a zone. A safe, approved method is available to disconnect its temperature sensor temporarily.
steps: Disconnect the temperature sensor using the approved method.
Check the thermostat display for the sensor error.
Reconnect the sensor and check for recovery.
expected: The thermostat displays E-217 for the affected zone while the sensor is disconnected. After reconnection, the error clears when the sensor is recognised.

title: Verify dial press opens a displayed alert
preconditions: A dismissible, non-critical alert is visible on the thermostat. The dial and display are operating normally.
steps: Press the dial once while the alert is shown.
Read the resulting screen.
Use the displayed control or guidance to return to the home screen.
expected: The press follows the alert's stated action, such as opening its details, rather than silently changing a heating setting. The alert and operating status remain understandable.

title: Receive an alert when the boiler stops responding
preconditions: The Android app is signed in, notifications are enabled, and the paired thermostat can report boiler status. A safe test setup can simulate a non-responding boiler.
steps: Simulate the boiler not responding.
Wait for the thermostat to report the fault.
Check the Android notification shade.
expected: A notification identifies that the boiler is not responding and gives a clear next step. It does not report that heating is working normally.

title: Use half-degree away temperature
preconditions: The Android app is signed in and paired with an online thermostat. Away mode settings are available.
steps: Open away mode settings.
Choose an away temperature ending in .5 degrees.
Save the setting.
expected: The app saves and displays the half-degree value accurately. The thermostat receives the same target.

title: Handle two-step verification delivery failure
preconditions: A verified account has two-step verification enabled. The Android app is signed out, and the configured delivery channel is unavailable or can be simulated as failing.
steps: Enter the account's valid email and password and submit.
Wait for the two-step verification challenge.
Trigger or wait for the verification-code delivery failure.
Use any offered retry or alternate recovery option.
expected: The app clearly reports that a code could not be delivered and does not accept an absent code or grant account access. Any retry or alternate option is clearly presented and usable.

title: Disable away mode manually
preconditions: The Android app is signed in and paired with an online thermostat. Away mode is on.
steps: Open the home controls.
Turn off away mode.
expected: Away mode is shown as off. The thermostat resumes the active schedule or normal target temperature.

title: Reject an already registered email address
preconditions: A Dormouse account already exists for the test email address. The tester is signed out of the Android app.
steps: Choose to create an account.
Enter the existing email address and a valid password.
Submit the form.
expected: The app does not create a duplicate account. It gives a clear message and offers an appropriate sign-in or account-help route.

title: Sign in with valid credentials
preconditions: A verified account exists and the tester is signed out of the web dashboard.
steps: Open the sign-in page.
Enter the account's valid email and password.
Submit the form.
Review the resulting page.
expected: The tester is signed in and can access the account dashboard. The displayed account identity matches the credentials used.

title: Receive frost protection notification
preconditions: The iOS app is signed in, notifications are allowed, and a paired thermostat is online. Frost protection is set to 5 degrees.
steps: Set the target to 5 degrees using the app.
Wait for the thermostat to apply the setting.
Check the iPhone notification centre.
expected: If the product sends a notification for entering frost protection, it identifies the correct thermostat and 5 degrees. No notification claims that heating is active unless the thermostat reports it.

title: Show error for unavailable Wi-Fi network
preconditions: The thermostat is in pairing mode. The app can scan nearby networks, but the network selected for the test is out of range or switched off.
steps: Start pairing in the app and scan for networks.
Select the unavailable network if it is listed, or enter its details manually.
Attempt to continue with pairing.
expected: Pairing does not complete, and the thermostat displays E-101. The app explains that the Wi-Fi network cannot be found and offers a retry.

title: Cancel member removal confirmation
preconditions: The owner is signed in and at least one household member is active.
steps: Open the household member list.
Select a member and start the removal flow.
Cancel at the confirmation prompt.
expected: The member remains in the household with their existing access. The app does not show a removal success message.

title: Check dial press during a screen transition
preconditions: The thermostat is powered on and a screen transition can be triggered using the dial.
steps: Press the dial to trigger a screen change.
Press it once more while the screen is transitioning.
Wait for the display to settle.
expected: The display settles on a valid screen without duplicate actions, corrupted text or an unresponsive control.

title: Check boost ends after one hour
preconditions: The thermostat is online and the dashboard can start a boost. A test environment or clock control is available to observe the one-hour expiry.
steps: Start a one-hour boost from the dashboard.
Record the displayed start and expiry times.
Wait until one hour after the start, or advance the test clock.
Refresh the dashboard and check the boost status.
expected: The boost ends at the one-hour expiry without requiring user action. The dashboard shows boost as inactive and normal heating control resumes.

title: Check readings with display asleep and awake
preconditions: The thermostat is powered and both sensors are functioning. The display has an automatic sleep behaviour.
steps: Allow the display to go to sleep.
Press the dial to wake it.
Check the temperature and humidity readings.
expected: Waking the display presents current sensor readings without requiring a reboot or menu navigation.

title: Refresh report after data becomes available
preconditions: The app is signed in to a home where a selected month's report is initially unavailable and can later be populated with energy data.
steps: Open the selected month's report while it has no data.
Make energy data available for that month in the test environment.
Refresh the report or leave and reopen it.
expected: The report updates to show the newly available data and does not remain stuck on a stale empty state.

title: Check report for a selected zone
preconditions: The home has at least two zones with thermostats and monthly energy reports. The Android app is signed in.
steps: Open the energy reports for the home.
Select a zone, if the report offers a zone filter.
Switch to another zone and compare the displayed report.
expected: When zone filtering is available, the report identifies the selected zone and updates its data accordingly. If reports are only available for the whole home, the app clearly indicates that scope.

title: Use schedule controls with large text
preconditions: Android display text size is set to the largest supported setting. The user is signed in and can open a thermostat schedule.
steps: Open the schedule editor.
Review the period list and save controls at the configured text size.
Edit a period and save.
expected: Schedule values and essential controls remain readable and usable without being clipped or covered. The user can complete and confirm the save.

title: Complete two-step verification with a valid code
preconditions: A verified account has two-step verification enabled, and the tester can receive its verification code.
steps: Sign in with the correct email and password.
Retrieve the current verification code.
Enter the code and submit it.
expected: The app accepts the valid code and signs in to the account.

title: Sort notifications by date
preconditions: A user account is signed in and has at least three notifications with different timestamps.
steps: Open the notifications view.
Choose the available newest-first sort order.
Check the order of the displayed timestamps.
expected: Notifications appear from newest to oldest by timestamp. Each notification's displayed timestamp agrees with its position.

title: Check the display after a prolonged idle
preconditions: The thermostat is powered on and showing its normal home screen. No control is being used.
steps: Leave the thermostat untouched for five minutes.
Observe whether the display dims or changes.
Touch or press the dial once.
expected: Any idle display behaviour is consistent and legible. A dial press wakes or returns the display to its usable home view without altering settings.

title: Check humidity sensor response to gradual change
preconditions: The thermostat is powered with its humidity sensor connected. A safe humidity change can be made near the thermostat without wetting the device.
steps: Record the displayed humidity.
Gradually increase nearby humidity without spraying or wetting the thermostat.
Wait for the reading to update.
Allow the room to return towards its original condition.
expected: The displayed humidity responds to the change and returns towards its original reading as conditions recover. No humidity fault appears.

title: Change a scheduled target locally
preconditions: A schedule is configured for the thermostat's zone and local schedule editing is available.
steps: Open a scheduled period on the thermostat.
Change its target by one half-degree using the dial.
Confirm the edit and reopen that period.
expected: The edited period shows the new target after confirmation. Other periods and zones remain unchanged.

title: Account recovery regression: every way back into a locked account
preconditions: Three test accounts: one with a forgotten password, one locked after five wrong attempts, one with two-step verification switched on.
steps: Request a reset link for the first account, change its password and log in.
Request a second link and check the first one has stopped working.
Wait 30 minutes on the locked account, then log in with the right password.
Log in to the third account on a new phone and enter the emailed code.
Repeat each path with the phone in airplane mode and check the error messages.
expected: Every account can be recovered. Used and replaced links are refused, the lock lifts after 30 minutes, and every offline attempt shows a clear 'No connection' message.

title: Update while cloud is unreachable
preconditions: The thermostat is connected to Wi-Fi but cannot reach the Dormouse cloud, producing E-110.
steps: Confirm E-110 is visible.
Open the firmware update option and attempt an update check.
Inspect the message and firmware version.
expected: The thermostat reports the cloud connection problem and does not claim an update is available or installed without confirmation. The current firmware remains usable.

title: Add the fourth zone
preconditions: The iOS app is signed in as the home owner. Three thermostats are assigned to the home, and a fourth unassigned thermostat is available.
steps: Open the option to add a zone.
Pair the fourth thermostat and assign it to the home.
Return to the zone list.
expected: The fourth thermostat is added as a zone and appears in the zone list. No limit warning is shown.

title: Update during mains power interruption
preconditions: An update is available and the test environment can interrupt mains power to the thermostat safely. Backup batteries are installed.
steps: Interrupt mains power before the update window.
Check the thermostat display and iOS app for power status.
Restore mains power and check update status.
expected: The thermostat reports E-402 for interrupted mains power, and the app does not report an update as completed without confirmation. After power is restored, the app shows the actual update eligibility and result.

title: Create a daily schedule on the thermostat
preconditions: The thermostat is powered, paired, and connected to a home with a working boiler. A schedule has not been set for the selected day.
steps: Press the dial to open the thermostat menu.
Turn the dial to Schedules and press it.
Choose a day, add a period, and set its start time and target temperature.
Save the schedule and review the displayed periods.
expected: The thermostat saves and displays the new period with the selected day, start time, and target temperature.

title: Return from frost protection to normal heating
preconditions: Frost protection is active for an online thermostat. The dashboard is signed in and can control the zone.
steps: Open the zone's heating mode controls.
Select normal heating.
Set a target of 19 degrees.
Save the change and check the status.
expected: Frost protection is no longer active and the zone shows a 19-degree target. The thermostat responds to normal heating demand.

title: Cancel zone removal
preconditions: The iOS app is signed in as the home owner. The home has at least two zones.
steps: Open settings for a zone.
Choose the option to remove the zone.
Cancel at the confirmation prompt.
expected: The zone remains in the home and its settings are unchanged.

title: Reject an invitation
preconditions: A valid household invitation is available to the invitee. The invitee can open its link in a browser.
steps: Open the invitation link.
Choose to decline the invitation.
Return to the invitation or sign in to the dashboard.
expected: The invitation is declined and the invitee does not gain access to the home. The dashboard shows the invitation as declined or no longer available.

title: Reject duplicate period start times
preconditions: An owner is signed in and has an online thermostat with a configured zone. The test day already has a period starting at 08:00.
steps: Open the test day's schedule.
Add another period with the same 08:00 start time.
Attempt to save.
expected: The dashboard prevents ambiguous duplicate start times and explains the conflict. The previously saved period remains unchanged.

title: Check notification respects household access
preconditions: The iOS app is signed in as a household member with access to one shared home. The member can receive a test notification from an authorised thermostat.
steps: Generate a test event on a thermostat in the shared home.
Check the member's notification centre.
Open the notification and review the available details.
expected: The member receives only information for the home and zones they are authorised to access. The notification does not expose another household's data.

title: Check the four-zone limit
preconditions: Four thermostats are assigned to four zones in one home. A fifth thermostat is paired but unassigned.
steps: On the fifth thermostat, open its zone assignment view.
Attempt to assign it as a new zone.
Review the displayed result.
expected: A fifth zone is not created because the home is at the four-zone limit. Existing zones remain available and unchanged.

title: Power interruption during update download
preconditions: An update is downloading on the thermostat. A controlled means to interrupt and restore its mains supply is available.
steps: Start the update and wait for download progress.
Interrupt mains power during the download, then restore it.
Wait for startup and inspect firmware and update status.
expected: The thermostat starts safely and does not report a partial update as successful. It retains valid firmware and provides a safe retry or recovery option.

title: Check large text and display scaling in pairing
preconditions: Android display size and font size are set larger than default. The thermostat is in pairing mode and a 2.4 GHz network is available.
steps: Open the app and start pairing.
Review the network selection, password, and confirmation screens at the configured display size.
Complete pairing using the visible controls.
expected: Text and controls remain readable and usable without critical content being clipped or obscured. Pairing completes successfully.

title: Lower target by one half-degree
preconditions: The thermostat is online and the iOS app is signed in. Its current target is 20 degrees.
steps: Open the thermostat controls in the iOS app.
Decrease the target once.
Check the displayed target in the app and on the thermostat.
expected: The target changes from 20 to 19.5 degrees and both displays agree.

title: Check screen reader labels for heating controls
preconditions: A screen reader is enabled in a supported desktop browser. The user is signed in and an online zone is available.
steps: Open the zone's heating controls.
Move through the target, mode and boost controls with the screen reader.
Change the target to 20 degrees and save.
Listen for the resulting status announcement.
expected: Each control has a meaningful accessible name and communicates its current value or state. Saving announces the updated 20-degree target and any heating status change.

title: Reject password change with an incorrect current password
preconditions: The tester is signed in and account security settings are available.
steps: Open password change settings.
Enter an incorrect current password and a valid new password.
Submit the change.
expected: The password is not changed. A clear error is shown and the existing password continues to work.

title: Reject expired two-step verification code
preconditions: An account with two-step verification enabled is available, and a valid sign-in method is accessible. The dashboard is signed out.
steps: Enter the account credentials to reach the verification step.
Wait until the displayed verification code expires.
Submit the expired code.
expected: The code is rejected with a clear error message, and access to the dashboard is not granted. The user can request or enter a current code.

title: Check boost while away mode is active
preconditions: The Android app is connected, away mode is on, and the one-hour boost control is available.
steps: Start a one-hour boost from the app.
Check the displayed mode and target.
Wait briefly and review the controls again.
expected: The app clearly communicates how boost interacts with away mode and shows the effective target. The state shown by the app matches the thermostat.

title: Show a useful error when sign-in is offline
preconditions: The iOS app is installed and signed out. The device has a working internet connection before the test begins.
steps: Enable Airplane Mode.
Enter valid account credentials on the sign-in screen.
Submit the sign-in form.
Review the message and available controls.
expected: Sign-in does not succeed. The app clearly explains that a connection is unavailable and provides a way to retry after connectivity is restored.

title: Schedule the maximum target temperature
preconditions: The thermostat is paired and a schedule can be edited. The selected day has an editable period.
steps: Open the period in the schedule editor.
Set its target temperature to 30 degrees.
Save the schedule.
Reopen the period and inspect its target.
expected: The thermostat accepts and displays 30 degrees as the period's target temperature.

title: Check report with two-step verification account
preconditions: The account has two-step verification enabled and has an available monthly report.
steps: Sign out of the app.
Sign in with the account password and complete two-step verification.
Open the energy reports.
expected: After successful verification, the report is accessible and shows the signed-in home's data.

title: Check response to disconnected temperature sensor
preconditions: The thermostat is powered on and operating normally. A controlled method is available to disconnect and reconnect its temperature sensor.
steps: Disconnect the temperature sensor.
Observe the thermostat display.
Reconnect the sensor.
expected: The thermostat displays E-217 while the sensor is disconnected. After reconnection, the error clears and the temperature reading returns.

title: Check sharing controls with Voice Control
preconditions: Voice Control is enabled on the iPhone and the owner is signed in to the Dormouse iOS app.
steps: Open household sharing for the home.
Use spoken commands to navigate to the invite control.
Activate the control and enter a valid email address using Voice Control.
Send the invitation.
expected: The invite control and relevant fields can be identified and operated with Voice Control, and the invitation is sent successfully.

title: Set a schedule temperature at the minimum
preconditions: The Android app is signed in and a paired thermostat is available for schedule editing.
steps: Open a schedule period's temperature control.
Set the temperature to 5 degrees and save.
expected: The schedule saves the period at 5 degrees and displays that value when reopened.

title: Check E-305 boiler not responding display
preconditions: The boiler can be safely made unavailable using an approved test setup while the thermostat remains powered.
steps: Make the boiler unavailable using the approved setup.
Request heating by raising the target above the room temperature.
Observe the thermostat display.
expected: The thermostat displays E-305 to indicate that the boiler is not responding. The display remains usable for viewing the error and controls.

title: Recover from report load failure
preconditions: The app is signed in and has report data. A network shaping tool can block access to the Dormouse cloud.
steps: Block cloud access on the Android device.
Open the energy reports.
Restore cloud access and use the app's retry action, if shown.
expected: The app shows a clear error or unavailable state while cloud access is blocked. After access is restored and retry is used, the report loads correctly.

title: Verify schedule state on the display
preconditions: A schedule with distinct targets for the current and next period is configured. The thermostat is online and the current time is correct.
steps: Check the home screen during the current schedule period.
Wait for the next period to begin, or safely advance the schedule using the supported setup method.
Check the displayed target and schedule status.
expected: The display reflects the target for the active schedule period and updates when the next period begins. It does not show a stale target from the previous period.

title: Mark a notification as read
preconditions: A user account is signed in and has an unread notification.
steps: Open the notifications view.
Mark the unread notification as read.
Refresh the view.
expected: The notification is shown as read after refreshing. Its message and timestamp remain unchanged.

title: Reject a used invitation link
preconditions: A household invitation has already been accepted or cancelled. The original invitation link is available.
steps: Open the old invitation link in a browser.
Try to accept the invitation again.
expected: The dashboard reports that the invitation is no longer valid or has already been used. It does not create a duplicate membership.
