title: Check energy report notification link
preconditions: The iOS app is signed in, report notifications are enabled if available, and a valid report notification can be delivered.
steps: Tap the energy report notification.
Observe the report that opens.
expected: The app opens the relevant report or its report landing page. The displayed household and month match the notification.

title: Recover scheduled target at next period
preconditions: The thermostat is online with two schedule periods set to different targets. The next period is due to start soon, and the iOS app is signed in.
steps: Confirm the current period and target in the iOS app.
Wait until the next scheduled period begins.
Check the target and heating status in the app.
expected: At the period change, the app shows the next period's target and heating responds to that target.

title: Check notifications with network restored
preconditions: The iOS app is signed in and notifications are allowed. A paired thermostat can generate test events, and the iPhone can be taken offline temporarily.
steps: Turn on Airplane Mode on the iPhone.
Generate a test event and note the time.
Turn off Airplane Mode and restore internet access.
Check the notification centre and app event details.
expected: The app shows the event according to its delivery behaviour once connectivity returns, with its correct event details and time. It does not create duplicate alerts for the same event.

title: Check owner limit for household sharing
preconditions: The account is at the maximum of eight household members, and the owner is signed in to the Android app.
steps: Open household sharing settings.
Attempt to add another member.
Return to away mode controls.
expected: The app prevents adding a ninth member and explains the limit. Existing away mode controls and settings remain unchanged.

title: Enable away mode manually
preconditions: The Android app is signed in and paired with an online thermostat. Away mode is off.
steps: Open the home controls.
Turn on away mode.
expected: Away mode is shown as on in the app. The thermostat uses the away temperature setting.

title: Check away mode state after phone restart
preconditions: Away mode is on, geofencing is configured, and the Android phone can be restarted safely.
steps: Restart the Android phone.
Open the Dormouse app after restart.
Check away mode and geofencing status.
expected: The app displays the confirmed away mode state and retains the geofencing configuration. It does not trigger an unintended mode change solely because the phone restarted.

title: Check notification delivery after the phone reconnects
preconditions: The Android app is signed in and notifications are enabled. The thermostat can generate a test alert, and the phone can be temporarily disconnected from the internet.
steps: Disconnect the phone from the internet.
Generate a thermostat alert that remains current.
Reconnect the phone to the internet.
Check the notification shade and app.
expected: The app delivers the still-relevant alert after reconnection or shows it in the app's notification history. It does not present an outdated alert as a current condition if that condition has cleared.

title: View schedules for different zones
preconditions: Two zones exist and each has a schedule configured. The Android app is signed in to the home.
steps: Open the first zone's schedule and note its periods.
Open the second zone's schedule.
Compare the displayed periods with the configured schedules.
expected: Each zone shows its own schedule and up to six daily periods. Opening one zone's schedule does not display the other's periods as its own.

title: Use the schedule with keyboard navigation
preconditions: An owner is signed in to the web dashboard using a keyboard without a mouse. A zone has an existing schedule.
steps: Use Tab and Shift+Tab to reach the schedule controls.
Use keyboard controls to open and edit a period.
Save the change and inspect the result using the keyboard.
expected: All schedule controls can be reached and operated using the keyboard, with a visible focus indicator. The saved change is announced or otherwise clearly indicated.

title: Lower target temperature below the room reading
preconditions: The thermostat is powered on and the room is warmer than the currently selected target. The boiler is operating normally.
steps: Turn the dial anticlockwise to set a target below the room temperature.
Press the dial to confirm.
expected: The display shows the lower target. The thermostat does not request heating while the measured room temperature remains above it.

title: Verify boiler status after demand ends
preconditions: The thermostat is paired with a responsive boiler and is showing active heating demand.
steps: Set a target that ends the heating demand using an approved control method.
Allow the boiler to respond.
Check the thermostat display for heating status.
expected: The display removes or changes its active-heating indication when demand ends. It does not continue to imply that the boiler is firing.

title: Check away mode control with Bluetooth disabled
preconditions: The Android app is signed in, the phone has internet access, and the thermostat is online. Away mode is off.
steps: Turn off Bluetooth on the phone.
Open the home's controls in the app.
Enable away mode and inspect the displayed state.
expected: Away mode enables successfully over the network without requiring Bluetooth, and the app shows it as active.

title: Invite an existing Dormouse user
preconditions: An owner is signed in. The intended invitee already has a Dormouse account and is not a member of this home.
steps: Invite the email address used by the existing account.
Open the invitation from that account.
Accept the invitation and view the home.
expected: The existing account joins the home without creating a duplicate account. The member list shows the account once.

title: Check boiler fault indication on thermostat
preconditions: The thermostat is powered on and connected to a boiler that can be placed into a controlled fault state.
steps: Cause the boiler to report a fault using the approved test method.
Observe the thermostat display.
expected: The thermostat displays E-312 to indicate the boiler-reported fault.

title: Check household access after sign out
preconditions: A member has accepted an invitation and has previously opened the shared home in a browser.
steps: Sign out of the member account.
Open the shared home's dashboard URL directly.
Try to view home or thermostat information.
expected: The dashboard requires sign-in before showing household information. No private home or thermostat data is exposed while signed out.

title: Delete a scheduled period
preconditions: The selected day has at least two saved periods. The thermostat is powered and responsive to the dial.
steps: Open Schedules and select the day.
Choose one period and select Delete.
Confirm the deletion if prompted.
Review the day's remaining periods.
expected: The chosen period is removed. All other periods remain unchanged.

title: Move a thermostat to another zone
preconditions: An owner is signed in to the web dashboard. Two zones exist, and one thermostat is assigned to the first zone.
steps: Open the thermostat's zone assignment controls.
Move it from the first zone to the second zone.
Save and inspect both zone details.
expected: The thermostat appears in the second zone and no longer appears in the first. Its settings and readings are associated with its new zone.

title: Check pairing prompts are usable without colour
preconditions: The thermostat is powered and unpaired. Pairing prompts include status or selection indications that can be assessed without relying on colour.
steps: Open pairing and navigate to a network selection.
Check the selected state using text, icons or position rather than colour.
Trigger a recoverable pairing error and inspect its indication.
expected: Selection and error states are distinguishable through text, icons or layout as well as any colour. Pairing is not dependent on colour alone.

title: Turn heating on by raising target
preconditions: The thermostat is online, the boiler is responsive, and the measured temperature is below the current target. The iOS app is signed in.
steps: Open the thermostat controls in the iOS app.
Raise the target above the measured temperature.
Observe the heating status and boiler response.
expected: The app indicates a call for heat and the boiler starts heating. The thermostat target remains the value selected.

title: Check separate alerts for separate zones
preconditions: The iOS app is signed in and notifications are allowed. Two thermostats are paired to separate zones in the same home and can generate test events.
steps: Generate a test event on the first zone.
Generate a different test event on the second zone.
Review both notifications in the notification centre.
expected: Each notification identifies the correct zone and event. The events are not combined in a way that misattributes either thermostat.

title: Check readings remain available offline
preconditions: The thermostat is powered and both sensors are functioning. The thermostat can be safely disconnected from the internet without removing power.
steps: Record the displayed temperature and humidity.
Disconnect the thermostat from the internet while leaving it powered.
Wake the thermostat display.
Check both readings.
expected: The thermostat continues to display local temperature and humidity readings while offline. Sensor readings are not replaced by a cloud connectivity error.

title: Update while a one-hour boost is active
preconditions: The thermostat is online, an update is available, and a one-hour heating boost is active.
steps: Record the displayed target temperature and remaining boost time.
Start the firmware update from the thermostat.
After restart, inspect heating status and the boost.
expected: The update completes without an unsafe boiler command during restart. Afterward, heating returns to a clearly defined safe state and the boost is either resumed with its remaining time or clearly reported as cancelled.

title: Save schedule after leaving editor
preconditions: The thermostat is paired and an existing schedule can be edited. A harmless change can be made and reverted.
steps: Open a scheduled period and make a small change.
Save the change and return to the home display.
Reopen the schedule and inspect the period.
expected: The saved change remains present after leaving and reopening the schedule editor.

title: Handle leading and trailing email spaces
preconditions: A verified account exists and the tester is signed out.
steps: Enter the registered email with spaces before and after it.
Enter the correct password.
Submit the sign-in form.
expected: The dashboard trims harmless surrounding whitespace or clearly rejects it; it must not silently authenticate as a different account. The result is understandable to the user.

title: Press the dial to open its main control
preconditions: The thermostat is showing its normal home screen.
steps: Press the centre of the dial once.
Observe the display.
Press the dial again to leave the control.
expected: The first press opens the intended main control without changing the target unexpectedly. The second press returns to the home screen.

title: Set the maximum target temperature
preconditions: The thermostat is powered on and its target can be adjusted. The target is below 30 degrees.
steps: Turn the dial clockwise until the target reaches 30 degrees.
Turn the dial clockwise once more.
Check the displayed target.
expected: The display shows 30 degrees and does not go above it.

title: Check error display does not block dial input
preconditions: The thermostat is displaying a recoverable error that permits on-device interaction, such as E-101.
steps: Turn the dial once while the error is displayed.
Press the dial once.
Observe whether the display responds and remains stable.
expected: The display responds to supported input without freezing, corrupting the error text, or dismissing the error without user action.

title: Show notifications for the correct home
preconditions: A signed-in account has access to at least two homes, with notifications available for one of them.
steps: Open the notifications view for the first home.
Inspect the available home selector or notification context.
Switch to the second home and inspect its notifications.
expected: Notifications are scoped to the selected home. No notification from one home is presented as belonging to the other.

title: Check schedule contrast and colour-independent states
preconditions: The iOS app is signed in and a schedule with multiple target values is available. iOS is set to a high-contrast or colour-filter accessibility setting if supported.
steps: Open the weekly schedule.
Inspect selected days, active periods and target values.
Change a period and inspect any saved or error state.
expected: Schedule information and states remain distinguishable without relying on colour alone. Text and controls remain legible under the enabled accessibility setting.

title: Check a member's household access
preconditions: A member has accepted an invitation and is signed in to the web dashboard. The shared home has at least one thermostat.
steps: Open the shared home.
View thermostat status and settings.
Change a target temperature and save it.
Refresh the page.
expected: The member can view the shared home's thermostat and make the supported heating change. The saved target is shown after refresh.

title: Check low backup battery warning
preconditions: The thermostat is powered on with backup batteries installed. A controlled method is available to bring the batteries to a low state.
steps: Bring the backup batteries to a low state using the approved test method.
Observe the thermostat display and heating status.
expected: The thermostat displays E-401 and continues to show its heating status without displaying a different error.

title: Check humidity response to a controlled moist change
preconditions: The thermostat is in a stable room and its displayed humidity has settled. A safe way to raise room humidity gradually is available without exposing the thermostat to liquid or condensation.
steps: Record the displayed humidity.
Gradually raise room humidity without directing moisture at the thermostat.
Observe the displayed humidity at intervals.
Stop before condensation forms.
expected: The displayed humidity trends up as room humidity rises, without implausible abrupt changes. No condensation or sensor fault is caused by the test.

title: Deactivate boost using its button
preconditions: A one-hour boost is active and its status is shown on the thermostat.
steps: Press the boost button once.
Check the displayed boost status.
Wait briefly and check that the normal control state is shown.
expected: Boost ends and the display no longer indicates an active boost. Normal heating control is restored.

title: Schedule a period at midnight
preconditions: The iOS app is signed in and the selected day has room for another period. The thermostat is online.
steps: Add a period with a start time of 00:00.
Set its target to 18 degrees.
Save and inspect the day and adjacent day.
expected: The app displays the period at 00:00 on the intended day. It does not shift the period to the previous or following day.

title: Check long Wi-Fi password entry
preconditions: The thermostat is powered and unpaired. A 2.4 GHz network uses a valid long password that is available for entry.
steps: Select the network and open password entry.
Enter the entire password using the dial and press controls.
Review the entered value using the available display controls.
Submit the password and wait for pairing.
expected: The thermostat accepts the full valid password without truncating or altering it. Pairing completes successfully.

title: Keep account settings private between household members
preconditions: A Dormouse home has an owner and a separate member account. Both accounts can sign in to the web dashboard.
steps: Sign in as the owner and open account settings.
Sign out, then sign in as the member in the same browser.
Open the member's account settings.
expected: The member sees only their own account details and cannot view or change the owner's credentials or personal account settings.

title: Each room keeps its own temperature in a two-zone home
preconditions: Two thermostats paired to one home as 'Living room' and 'Bedroom'.
steps: Set the living room to 21 degrees and the bedroom to 17 degrees.
Wait for both to reach their targets.
Change the bedroom to 18 degrees.
expected: Each zone heats to its own target, and changing the bedroom does not change the living room.

title: Handle thermostat offline during away change
preconditions: The Android app is signed in. The paired thermostat is offline while the phone has internet access.
steps: Turn on away mode in the app.
Check the change status shown by the app.
Bring the thermostat back online and refresh.
expected: The app does not claim the thermostat applied an unconfirmed change. After reconnection, the thermostat and app converge on the saved away mode state or report that it needs retrying.

title: Receive a boost completion notification
preconditions: The Android app is signed in and notifications are enabled. A paired thermostat is online, and a one-hour boost can be started.
steps: Start a one-hour boost in the app.
Wait for the boost to finish.
Check the Android notification shade and the app.
expected: A notification reports that the boost has ended, without claiming it is still active. The app and thermostat show the current heating state.

title: Update with temperature sensor disconnected
preconditions: The thermostat is online, an update is available, and the display shows E-217.
steps: Confirm E-217 is visible.
Attempt to start the firmware update from the thermostat.
Inspect the temperature reading and heating state.
expected: The thermostat does not present an invalid temperature as valid. It clearly reports the sensor fault and keeps heating in a safe, predictable state during and after the update.

title: Keep pairing controls responsive during scan
preconditions: The thermostat is powered and unpaired. Wi-Fi scanning can be observed on its display.
steps: Open pairing and start or wait for a network scan.
Turn the dial while the scan is in progress.
Press the dial to open an available screen option.
expected: The display remains responsive to dial input during scanning. The scan does not cause a frozen display or an unintended selection.

title: Validate malformed email in password reset
preconditions: The iOS app is open on the password reset screen.
steps: Enter an email address with invalid syntax.
Submit the reset request.
expected: The app identifies the invalid email format and does not submit a reset request.

title: Set away temperature
preconditions: The Android app is signed in and paired with an online thermostat. Away mode settings are available.
steps: Open away mode settings.
Set the away temperature to a valid value.
Save the setting.
expected: The app saves and displays the chosen away temperature. The thermostat uses it when away mode is active.

title: Save a schedule with a weak Wi-Fi signal
preconditions: The thermostat is paired and reachable, but its Wi-Fi signal is weak. The Android app is signed in.
steps: Open the thermostat schedule in the app.
Change one period and save.
Check the save status and reopen the schedule.
expected: The app gives a clear success or failure status without freezing. If saved, the reopened schedule contains the change; if not, the prior schedule remains intact.

title: Check notification for disconnected temperature sensor
preconditions: The iOS app is signed in and notifications are allowed. A paired thermostat is in a test setup that can report a disconnected temperature sensor.
steps: Disconnect or simulate a disconnected temperature sensor.
Wait for the app to receive the status.
Check the iPhone notification centre.
expected: The app notifies the user of the temperature sensor issue and identifies the affected thermostat. It does not present an unavailable reading as a valid current temperature.

title: Handle boiler not responding
preconditions: The thermostat is online and the iOS app is signed in. The boiler can be made unresponsive safely for this test.
steps: Set a target above the measured temperature in the iOS app.
Make the boiler unresponsive using the approved test setup.
Check the app notification and thermostat display.
expected: The thermostat reports E-305 and the app reports that the boiler is not responding. The app does not indicate that heating is being delivered successfully.

title: Resend a pending invitation
preconditions: An owner is signed in and a household invitation is pending but has not been accepted.
steps: Open household sharing settings.
Resend the invitation.
Check the invitee's email.
expected: The dashboard confirms the invitation was resent. The invitee receives a usable invitation without creating a second member entry.

title: Rotate dial to raise the target temperature
preconditions: The thermostat is powered on and not in a menu. Heating control is available.
steps: Turn the dial clockwise several clicks.
Read the target temperature on the display.
expected: The target temperature increases in half-degree steps. The displayed value matches the selected target.

title: Check readings when the sensor area is briefly shaded
preconditions: The thermostat is powered and displaying live readings. A clean, dry card can be held nearby without touching or covering the thermostat.
steps: Record both displayed readings.
Hold the card near the sensor area for 30 seconds without contact.
Remove the card and check both readings.
expected: Both readings remain displayed and available; briefly shading the sensor area does not cause a fault or leave the readings blank.

title: Check notification text at large Android font size
preconditions: The Android app is signed in and notifications are enabled. Android's display or font size can be increased, and a safe test alert can be generated.
steps: Increase Android's font size to its largest practical setting.
Generate a thermostat alert.
Expand and read the notification.
Open the notification in the app.
expected: The alert remains legible and its key meaning is not clipped or obscured. The notification can still be opened and the relevant details remain readable in the app.

title: Prevent duplicate account creation from repeated taps
preconditions: The Android app is installed and signed out. A valid email address not yet registered is available, along with a valid password.
steps: Open the registration form and enter the email and password details.
Tap the create-account button repeatedly while the first submission is processing.
Wait for the registration result.
expected: Only one account-creation request is processed. The app gives a single clear success or error outcome and does not create duplicate accounts or leave the form stuck loading.

title: Set a schedule temperature at the maximum
preconditions: The Android app is signed in and a paired thermostat is available for schedule editing.
steps: Open a schedule period's temperature control.
Set the temperature to 30 degrees and save.
expected: The schedule saves the period at 30 degrees and displays that value when reopened.

title: Handle boiler reported fault
preconditions: The thermostat is online and a test setup can make the boiler report a fault. The dashboard can display device and heating status.
steps: Request heating by setting a target above room temperature.
Cause the boiler to report a fault.
Check the dashboard status and notifications.
Clear the test fault and check the status again.
expected: The dashboard reports a boiler fault and shows E-312 where device errors are available. It does not claim that heating is operating normally while the fault remains.

title: Verify a member cannot edit a read-only schedule
preconditions: A household member is signed in to the web dashboard with view-only access to a home's schedule.
steps: Open the zone's schedule.
Try to change a period or add a period.
Try to save any attempted change.
expected: The dashboard prevents schedule changes for a view-only member and does not apply any attempted edit. The current schedule remains intact.

title: Change between adjacent report months
preconditions: The iOS app is signed in and reports are available for two adjacent months.
steps: Open a monthly report.
Navigate to the next available month.
Navigate back to the original month.
expected: Each navigation shows the correct month and its associated data. Returning restores the original report.

title: Check report loading on slow network
preconditions: The app is signed in and has report data. A network shaping tool can provide a slow but working connection.
steps: Set the Android device to a slow network connection.
Open a month with report data.
Wait for the report to finish loading.
expected: A visible loading state appears while data is retrieved, then the correct report is shown without duplicate or partial values.

title: Check heating after boiler fault clears
preconditions: The thermostat is showing E-312 because the connected boiler reported a fault. The boiler can be safely restored to normal operation.
steps: Clear the boiler fault.
Observe the thermostat display.
Set a target above the room temperature and confirm it.
expected: E-312 clears after the boiler fault is resolved. The thermostat resumes requesting heat when the selected target is above the room temperature.

title: Check VoiceOver access to away controls
preconditions: The iOS app is signed in and away mode controls are available. VoiceOver is enabled on the iPhone.
steps: Navigate to the away mode control using VoiceOver.
Listen to the control's label and state.
Activate it and listen for the resulting status.
expected: VoiceOver announces a meaningful label and whether away mode is on or off. Activating the control changes the mode and the updated state is announced.

title: Check heating status updates after dial adjustment
preconditions: The thermostat is powered on and the boiler is responsive. The room temperature is close enough to the target that a small target change can alter heating demand.
steps: Observe the current heating status.
Adjust the target across the displayed room temperature and confirm it.
Observe the heating status again.
expected: The displayed heating status updates to reflect whether the new target calls for heat.

title: Notify owner when firmware update completes
preconditions: The owner has enabled app notifications. An update is scheduled and the Android device can receive notifications.
steps: Confirm that firmware update notifications are enabled in Android and the app.
Allow the overnight update to complete.
Check the Android notification tray and the app.
expected: The owner receives a completion notification, and the app shows the installed firmware version. No duplicate completion notifications are sent for the same update.

title: Check report with accessibility text size
preconditions: The iOS app is signed in and a monthly report is available; iOS accessibility text size can be increased.
steps: Increase iOS text size using Accessibility settings.
Open Energy reports and select a report.
Review headings, values and controls.
expected: Report headings, values and navigation remain readable at the selected text size. Text is not clipped in a way that hides essential report information or controls.

title: Assign a thermostat already in another zone
preconditions: Two zones exist, and a paired thermostat is assigned to the first zone. The app is signed in as the home owner.
steps: Open the second zone and choose Add thermostat.
Select the thermostat assigned to the first zone.
Review any confirmation or validation message and respond if offered.
expected: The thermostat is never assigned to both zones at once. The app either blocks the action or clearly confirms moving it, and the final assignment is unambiguous.

title: Stop heating by lowering target
preconditions: The thermostat is online, the boiler is responsive, and heating is active. The iOS app is signed in.
steps: Open the thermostat controls in the iOS app.
Lower the target below the measured temperature.
Observe the heating status and boiler response.
expected: The app indicates that there is no call for heat and the boiler stops heating.

title: Check temperature reading during boiler operation
preconditions: The thermostat is powered, paired, and controlling a working boiler. The room is below the selected target temperature.
steps: Record the displayed temperature and humidity.
Set a target above the current temperature using the dial.
Observe the sensor view while the boiler is called to heat.
expected: Both sensor readings remain visible while heating is requested; the displayed temperature changes only in response to the room conditions.

title: Update with the boost button pressed
preconditions: The thermostat is online, an update is available, and its display shows update progress.
steps: Start the update and wait until progress is visible.
Press the boost button once.
Observe the display and wait for the update to finish.
expected: The boost button does not interrupt firmware installation or trigger an unsafe heating change. The update completes with a clear status.

title: Resend a pending invitation
preconditions: The owner is signed in to the iOS app and a pending invitation is available to resend.
steps: Open household sharing for the home.
Select the pending invitation.
Choose to resend the invitation.
Check the app confirmation.
expected: The app confirms the resend and keeps one pending invitation for that email address.

title: Accept the same invitation twice
preconditions: A valid invitation has already been accepted by the invitee. The original invitation link remains available on the iPhone.
steps: Open the same invitation link again.
Try to accept the invitation a second time.
Check the home list.
expected: The app handles the link safely, does not create duplicate membership, and shows that the invitee already has access or that the invitation is no longer available.

title: Check display legibility from different angles
preconditions: The thermostat is powered on and showing readable temperature and status information.
steps: View the display from directly in front.
View it from above and from each side at a normal standing distance.
Check that key values and status indicators remain distinguishable.
expected: The target temperature and essential status information can be read from the tested viewing angles under the same room lighting.

title: Manual target change during schedule
preconditions: The thermostat is online and following a schedule. The iOS app is signed in.
steps: Open the thermostat controls in the iOS app.
Change the target from the scheduled value.
Check the displayed target and schedule status.
expected: The app applies the selected manual target and clearly shows the resulting heating state without displaying a conflicting target.

title: Check temperature display after Wi-Fi loss
preconditions: The thermostat is powered, its sensors are functioning and it is connected to Wi-Fi. The Wi-Fi access point can be switched off temporarily.
steps: Record the displayed temperature and humidity.
Switch off the Wi-Fi access point.
Wake the thermostat display.
Check both readings.
expected: Local temperature and humidity remain available despite Wi-Fi loss. The thermostat may show a network status indication, but it does not report a sensor fault.

title: Reject an incorrect Wi-Fi password
preconditions: The iOS app is installed and the user is signed in. The iPhone is connected to a 2.4 GHz network, and the thermostat is ready to pair.
steps: Start adding the thermostat.
Select the current Wi-Fi network and enter an incorrect password.
Submit the network details.
Review the app and thermostat display.
expected: The app does not report successful pairing and explains that the network credentials need checking. The thermostat remains unpaired and shows E-101 if it reports that the network cannot be found.

title: Cancel a pending invitation
preconditions: An owner is signed in and a household invitation is pending.
steps: Open household sharing settings.
Cancel the pending invitation.
Open the old invitation link as the invitee.
expected: The invitation is shown as cancelled and cannot be accepted. The invitee does not gain access to the home.

title: Reject an out-of-range zone target
preconditions: The iOS app is signed in with permission to control the home. The home has an online zone.
steps: Open the zone's temperature control.
Attempt to enter a target below 5 degrees or above 30 degrees.
Try to save the value.
expected: The app does not accept or send a target outside 5 to 30 degrees. The zone retains its previous valid target.

title: Turn the dial while a menu is open
preconditions: The thermostat is powered on and has a selectable on-device menu open.
steps: Turn the dial clockwise one click.
Observe which menu item is highlighted.
Turn the dial anticlockwise one click.
Observe the highlighted item.
expected: The highlight moves one item in the appropriate direction for each click. The menu does not activate an item merely because the dial is turned.

title: Handle boiler-reported fault
preconditions: The thermostat is online and paired. The boiler can be configured to report a fault, and the Android app is signed in.
steps: Configure the boiler to report a fault.
Request heat by setting a target above the room temperature in the app.
Check the thermostat display and app status.
expected: The thermostat displays E-312. The app clearly reports the boiler fault and does not show the requested heat as successfully delivered.

title: Check report during cloud outage
preconditions: A monthly report is available. A test environment can make the Dormouse cloud unreachable while the Android device remains online.
steps: Make the Dormouse cloud unreachable.
Open the energy reports.
Restore cloud access and reload the report.
expected: The app reports that cloud data cannot be reached rather than showing a fabricated report. After recovery, the report loads correctly.

title: Confirm targets use half-degree increments
preconditions: The thermostat is powered on and not in a menu. The target is 20 degrees.
steps: Turn the dial clockwise once.
Check the target value.
Turn the dial anticlockwise once.
Check the target value again.
expected: The target changes to 20.5 degrees and then returns to 20 degrees. No other increment is displayed.

title: Check target persists after returning home
preconditions: The thermostat is powered on and has a known target temperature set. The boiler is operating normally.
steps: Change the target by one half-degree step and confirm it.
Wait for the home screen to return.
Open the target control again.
expected: The target control shows the newly confirmed temperature after the home screen returns.

title: Use household sharing with larger text
preconditions: The iPhone has a larger Dynamic Type setting enabled. The owner is signed in to the Dormouse iOS app.
steps: Open household sharing for the home.
Review the member list and invitation actions at the selected text size.
Scroll through the screen and use the invite control.
expected: Text remains readable without clipping that prevents use, and sharing actions remain visible or reachable by scrolling.

title: Refresh a report after new usage
preconditions: The iOS app is signed in, a report is available, and new heating use can be recorded during the test.
steps: Open the current monthly report and note its displayed data.
Run heating for a short, controlled period.
Refresh or reopen the report.
expected: The report updates when refreshed data is available. The app does not display an update as complete while continuing to present stale data without indication.

title: Set the maximum scheduled temperature
preconditions: An owner is signed in and has an online thermostat with a configured zone.
steps: Add or edit a schedule period.
Set its target to 30 degrees and save.
Reopen the period.
expected: The dashboard accepts and displays 30 degrees as the period target. No validation error appears.

title: Check long notification content
preconditions: A signed-in user has a notification with a long message or a long home or zone name, generated through an approved test setup.
steps: Open the notifications view.
Inspect the long notification at the default window size.
Open its details if available.
expected: The full message can be read without overlapping controls or being clipped without a way to access the remaining text. The notification remains associated with the correct home or zone.

title: Check away mode when arriving home with a delayed exit
preconditions: An iPhone is signed in to the home owner's account with geofencing enabled and location permission set to Always. Away mode is active and the arrival behaviour is configured for the home.
steps: Bring the iPhone inside the home geofence.
Wait for the configured arrival processing period.
Check the mode in the app and at the thermostat.
expected: The home returns to its configured occupied mode after the arrival processing period. The app and thermostat show the same mode, without a brief unintended switch back to away.

title: Check Dynamic Type on away settings
preconditions: The iOS app is signed in and away settings are available. iOS text size is set to the largest supported accessibility size.
steps: Open away mode settings.
Review all labels, temperature values, and controls.
Change and save the away target.
expected: Text and controls remain readable and usable without critical content being clipped or obscured. The target can be changed and saved at the chosen text size.

title: Check readings are readable with screen dimmed
preconditions: The thermostat is powered and its display brightness can be reduced. Both sensor readings are available on the normal screen.
steps: Set the display to its lowest brightness setting.
Wake the display.
Read the temperature and humidity values.
expected: Both readings remain legible at the lowest supported brightness, with sufficient contrast to distinguish digits and units.

title: Check pairing leaves boiler control safe
preconditions: The thermostat is connected to a boiler and is not yet paired. The boiler is in a safe test condition, and its call-for-heat state can be observed.
steps: Observe the boiler demand before starting pairing.
Open the pairing flow and scan for Wi-Fi networks.
Cancel pairing without connecting to a network.
Check the boiler demand and thermostat display.
expected: Entering and cancelling pairing does not create an unintended heating demand. The thermostat returns to its normal unpaired state and the boiler remains in its prior safe state.

title: Check location permission denied
preconditions: The iOS app is installed and signed in. Location permission for the app is denied in iOS settings.
steps: Open the app's away mode settings.
Review the geofencing or location status.
Try to enable any location-based away option.
expected: The app explains that location permission is unavailable and provides an appropriate route to iOS settings. It does not imply that location-based away detection is working.

title: Handle an already-used invitation link
preconditions: A household invitation has already been accepted once. The original invitation link is available for another attempt.
steps: Open the previously used invitation link again.
Try to accept it using the same account.
Review the app response.
expected: The app does not create duplicate membership. It reports that the invitation was already used or that the account already belongs to the household.

title: Control a zone while another is offline
preconditions: The iOS app is signed in with permission to control the home. The home has two zones; one thermostat is offline and the other is online.
steps: Open the zone list.
Select the online zone and change its target temperature.
Open the offline zone's controls.
expected: The online zone accepts the target change. The app indicates that the offline zone cannot currently be reached and does not report an unconfirmed change as successful.

title: Handle a report service error
preconditions: The user is signed in. A test environment can make the energy report service return an error for a report request.
steps: Open the Energy reports page.
Request a report while the report service is returning an error.
expected: The dashboard shows a clear error message and does not present incomplete or stale figures as the requested report. Other dashboard navigation remains usable.

title: Handle lost cloud connection during change
preconditions: The thermostat is paired and normally online. A test setup can interrupt its connection to the Dormouse cloud during a dashboard action.
steps: Open the zone heating controls.
Interrupt the thermostat's cloud connection.
Change the target and submit it.
Restore the connection and check the resulting target.
expected: The dashboard clearly reports that the change could not be confirmed and does not show a false success. After reconnection, it displays the actual thermostat target and identifies E-110 if reported by the device.

title: Verify away control labels and status with Reduce Motion
preconditions: The iOS app is signed in and away mode is available. Reduce Motion is enabled in iOS Accessibility settings.
steps: Open the home's away controls in the app.
Switch between the away settings and home status screens.
Check that mode changes and status updates are presented without relying on animation.
expected: Away controls and current status remain clear and operable with Reduce Motion enabled. Any mode change is communicated through text or another non-motion cue.

title: Member leaves the household
preconditions: A member is signed in and belongs to a home with an owner and at least one other member.
steps: Open the home or account sharing settings.
Choose to leave the household and confirm.
Open the home dashboard again.
expected: The member's access to that home ends. The owner and other members retain access, and the member can no longer control its thermostats.

title: Resume pairing after Android app restart
preconditions: The thermostat is in pairing mode and a valid 2.4 GHz network is available. The Android app is signed in.
steps: Begin pairing and proceed to the network setup stage.
Force-stop and reopen the app.
Check the pairing state and continue or restart as prompted.
expected: The app presents a usable recovery path and does not show a falsely completed pairing. The thermostat is added once when setup succeeds.

title: Geofencing switches to away mode when everyone leaves home
preconditions: A household with two members, both with location sharing on, and a phone simulator that can fake its location.
steps: Move the first phone's location 2 km from home.
Check the thermostat is still in its normal mode.
Move the second phone's location 2 km from home and wait five minutes.
expected: Away mode only starts once both members have left. The thermostat drops to the away temperature and the app shows 'Everyone's out'.

title: Cancel a zone boost early
preconditions: A zone has an active one-hour boost. The Android app is signed in to the home.
steps: Open the boosted zone's controls.
Select the option to stop or cancel boost.
Check the zone status and thermostat display.
expected: Boost is no longer active for that zone and the thermostat reflects the change. Other zones' boost states are unchanged.

title: View report for a month with no data
preconditions: The user is signed in and can select a month for which the home has no energy report data.
steps: Open the Energy reports page.
Select the month with no data.
expected: The dashboard displays a clear no-data message for the selected period and does not show figures from another month as if they belonged to it.

title: Reject an incorrect password
preconditions: A verified account exists and the tester is signed out.
steps: Enter the account's valid email and an incorrect password.
Submit the sign-in form.
Review the response.
expected: Sign-in is denied and no account content is shown. A clear, non-revealing error message is displayed.

title: Rename an existing zone
preconditions: An owner is signed in to the web dashboard. A zone with one online thermostat exists.
steps: Open the zone's settings.
Change its name to a different valid name.
Save the change and reopen the zone list.
expected: The new name is shown in the zone list and zone details. The assigned thermostat remains in the zone.

title: Preserve schedule after firmware update
preconditions: A schedule with at least two periods is saved and active on the thermostat. An update is available and the thermostat is online.
steps: Record the schedule shown in the iOS app.
Allow the update to complete in the overnight window.
Reopen the schedule in the app and compare it with the recorded values.
expected: All schedule periods and target temperatures remain unchanged after the update. The schedule continues to control heating at its configured times.

title: Keep a session after a normal page refresh
preconditions: The tester is signed in and session persistence is enabled by the dashboard's normal policy.
steps: Refresh the current dashboard page.
Navigate to another account page.
Return to the original page.
expected: The valid session remains active and the tester can navigate without signing in again. No account data is lost.

title: Recover pairing after power interruption
preconditions: The thermostat is unpaired and a known 2.4 GHz network with a valid password is available. Safe access to interrupt and restore thermostat mains power is available.
steps: Start pairing and select the Wi-Fi network.
Interrupt mains power before confirming the password.
Restore power and wait for the thermostat to restart.
Start pairing again and complete setup with the valid password.
expected: After power is restored, the thermostat is usable and pairing can be started again. It pairs successfully and displays no persistent power or pairing error.

title: Cycle through home screen status panels
preconditions: Thermostat is powered, paired and showing its home screen. Room conditions and boiler status are normal.
steps: Use the dial to move through the available home screen status panels.
Pause on each panel long enough to read its contents.
Return to the first panel.
expected: Each panel shows its relevant status, such as target, room conditions or heating state, without blank or corrupted content. The home screen returns to its initial panel.

title: Update while the boiler reports a fault
preconditions: The thermostat is online, an update is available, and the boiler reports a fault shown as E-312.
steps: Confirm E-312 is visible on the thermostat.
Open the firmware update option and attempt to start it.
Check the displayed fault and update status.
expected: The thermostat keeps E-312 visible or clearly reports both conditions. It does not hide the boiler fault or issue heating commands that could worsen it.

title: Display local temperature reading during ordinary use
preconditions: The thermostat is powered and its temperature sensor is connected. The thermostat is in its normal heating screen.
steps: Wake the display if it is asleep.
Read the displayed room temperature.
Wait one minute and read it again.
expected: The display shows a numeric room temperature in degrees. The reading remains visible and updates without showing a sensor error.

title: Set maximum target temperature
preconditions: The thermostat is online and the iOS app is signed in. The current target is below 30 degrees.
steps: Open the thermostat controls in the iOS app.
Set the target to 30 degrees.
Try to increase the target further.
expected: The target is 30 degrees. The app does not allow a target above 30 degrees.

title: Check report colour contrast and non-colour cues
preconditions: The iOS app is signed in and a report containing charts or status colours is available.
steps: Open the report in light appearance.
Inspect chart series and status indicators.
Switch iOS appearance to dark mode and inspect them again.
expected: Text and essential chart details remain distinguishable in both appearances. Meaning is not conveyed by colour alone, and labels or other cues identify the data.

title: Check duplicate alerts across app and thermostat status updates
preconditions: The Android app is signed in and notifications are enabled. A safe test setup can generate one thermostat status change that may be reported more than once.
steps: Generate one thermostat status change.
Wait for its notification.
Allow the same status to be reported again without changing state.
Check the notification shade.
expected: The app presents one clear alert for the single event, or updates the existing alert. It does not create confusing duplicate notifications for unchanged status.

title: Check update window boundaries
preconditions: The thermostat is online and an update is available. The test environment can trigger or simulate update checks just before 02:00 and just after 04:00 local time.
steps: Open the iOS app before 02:00 and check the update status.
Check again during the permitted update window.
Check once more after 04:00 if the update has not started.
expected: The update does not install before 02:00 or after 04:00. If eligible, it installs only during the overnight window and its status is reported accurately in the app.

title: Check button operation with limited dexterity
preconditions: The thermostat is mounted in its normal position and showing the home screen. A tester with limited dexterity or a suitable usability participant is available.
steps: Operate the dial using a deliberate, light turn.
Press the dial without gripping or twisting the display housing.
Press the boost button using a comfortable single-finger motion.
expected: Each control can be operated without excessive force or accidental activation of another control. The display clearly reflects each accepted action.

title: Reject sign-in with an unknown email
preconditions: The tester has an email address that is not registered with Dormouse.
steps: Open the sign-in screen.
Enter the unregistered email and any password.
Submit the form.
expected: The app denies access with a suitable message and does not reveal whether unrelated accounts exist.

title: Prevent a seventh daily schedule period
preconditions: The iOS app is signed in with permission to manage schedules. A zone already has six periods on the selected day.
steps: Open that zone's schedule for the selected day.
Attempt to add another period.
Review the app response.
expected: The app prevents a seventh period from being added and leaves the six existing periods unchanged.

title: Start a one-hour boost in a zone
preconditions: A thermostat is assigned to an active zone and the boiler is available. The current target is below the boost target, if the product displays one.
steps: Press the boost button once.
Check the display for boost status and its duration.
Check that the zone requests heat when required.
expected: Boost starts for the selected zone and the display indicates it is active for one hour. Other zones are not shown as boosted.

title: Check access after member account is disabled
preconditions: A household member account can be disabled or suspended by the test environment. The account is currently an accepted member.
steps: Disable or suspend the member account using the approved test setup.
Open the Android app as that member or refresh its session.
Try to open the shared household.
expected: The disabled account cannot access the household. The app presents an appropriate sign-in or access error without exposing household information.

title: Check humidity stability in a steady room
preconditions: The thermostat is installed in a room with stable ambient conditions. The unit has been powered on long enough for its readings to settle.
steps: Note the displayed humidity.
Wait five minutes without touching the thermostat or changing room conditions.
Note the displayed humidity again.
Repeat the observation once.
expected: The humidity reading remains stable, with no unexplained repeated fluctuations. The display continues to show a valid humidity value.

title: Verify button press feedback
preconditions: The thermostat is on a screen where a dial press is accepted.
steps: Press the dial once briefly.
Observe the screen immediately after the press.
Repeat with a slightly longer press.
expected: Each accepted press gives clear visual feedback and performs the action once; a held press does not trigger repeated unintended actions.

title: Cancel a zone temperature edit
preconditions: An owner is signed in to the web dashboard. A zone has a saved target of 19 degrees.
steps: Open the zone target editor.
Change the value to 22 degrees.
Cancel or leave without saving, then reopen the editor.
expected: The saved target remains 19 degrees. The unsaved value of 22 degrees is not applied to the thermostat.

title: Recover from loss of internet while saving
preconditions: The iOS app is signed in and a thermostat has a saved schedule. Internet access can be disabled on the iPhone.
steps: Disable internet access on the iPhone.
Change a schedule target and try to save.
Restore internet access.
Follow any retry option and inspect the schedule.
expected: The app clearly reports that saving could not complete while offline and does not falsely confirm a cloud save. After connectivity returns, a retry saves the change once without duplicating periods.

title: View whole-home report across multiple zones
preconditions: The user's home has at least two zones with report data and a whole-home report option. The user can access the web dashboard.
steps: Open the Energy reports page.
Select the whole-home option.
expected: The report is identified as covering the whole home and includes data from the home's configured zones without presenting a single zone as the whole home.

title: Check notifications for a second zone
preconditions: The Android app is signed in and notifications are enabled. Two thermostats are paired in separate zones, and a safe test alert can be generated on the second thermostat.
steps: Generate an alert on the second thermostat.
Wait for the Android notification.
Open the alert in the app.
expected: The notification and app identify the correct second thermostat and zone. No status from the first thermostat is shown as the source of the alert.

title: Prevent a seventh schedule period
preconditions: An owner is signed in to the web dashboard. A zone schedule already has six periods for one day.
steps: Open the zone schedule editor.
Attempt to add a seventh period.
Review the available actions and any validation message.
expected: The dashboard does not save a seventh period. It clearly communicates the six-period limit and preserves the existing six periods.

title: Reject an out-of-range away temperature
preconditions: The iOS app is signed in and away mode settings allow a temperature to be entered.
steps: Open away mode settings.
Enter a target below 5 degrees or above 30 degrees.
Try to save the setting.
expected: The app does not save an out-of-range target. It displays a clear validation message or limits selection to the supported range of 5 to 30 degrees.

title: Pair using a Wi-Fi network with a captive portal
preconditions: The Android phone is connected to a 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi network that requires a browser sign-in before internet access. The thermostat is in pairing mode and the app is signed in.
steps: Start adding a thermostat in the app.
Select the connected Wi-Fi network and provide its credentials if requested.
Continue setup without completing the network's browser sign-in.
Observe the app and thermostat.
expected: Pairing does not report success while the network blocks internet access. The app gives a clear connection failure and allows the user to retry after internet access is available.

title: Reject an invalid temperature increment
preconditions: The iOS app is signed in and an editable schedule period is available.
steps: Edit the target using any text-entry control provided.
Enter 19.2 degrees.
Attempt to save.
expected: The app rejects or prevents the invalid increment and indicates that targets use half-degree steps. The saved target is not changed.

title: Press the dial to select a highlighted item
preconditions: A menu with at least two items is open, and one item is highlighted.
steps: Turn the dial to highlight a different item.
Press the dial once.
Observe the resulting screen.
expected: The highlighted item is selected and its corresponding screen or action opens.

title: Displayed temperature matches a reference thermometer within half a degree
preconditions: A thermostat in the climate chamber next to a calibrated reference thermometer.
steps: Set the chamber to 15, 20 and 25 degrees in turn.
At each one, wait ten minutes and compare the two readings.
expected: At every temperature the thermostat's reading is within 0.5 degrees of the reference.

title: Update with humidity sensor fault
preconditions: The thermostat is online, an update is available, and the display shows E-221.
steps: Confirm E-221 is visible.
Start the firmware update from the thermostat.
After restart, inspect the humidity status and firmware version.
expected: The update completes or reports a clear safe failure. E-221 is not silently cleared unless the humidity sensor has recovered.

title: Check password entry can be corrected
preconditions: The thermostat is powered and unpaired. A 2.4 GHz network and its correct password are available.
steps: Select the network and start password entry.
Enter several incorrect characters.
Use the displayed edit control to remove or change characters.
Complete the correct password and submit it.
expected: The password can be corrected before submission. The thermostat connects using the corrected password and completes pairing.

title: Navigate report controls by keyboard
preconditions: The user is signed in and an energy report is available. A keyboard is available; do not use a mouse during this test.
steps: Open the Energy reports page.
Use Tab and Shift+Tab to move through the report controls.
Use the keyboard to select another month or zone and activate the selection.
expected: All report controls can be reached and operated by keyboard, with a visible focus indicator. The selected report updates to match the keyboard selection.

title: Cancel an unconfirmed target change
preconditions: A thermostat is assigned to an active zone and has a known target temperature.
steps: Turn the dial to preview a different target.
Leave the dial unpressed until the preview ends or use the displayed cancel action.
Check the target shown for the zone.
expected: An unconfirmed change is not applied. The zone retains its previous target.

title: Check zone boiler fault reporting
preconditions: The iOS app is signed in. A test zone can be made to report boiler error E-305 or E-312.
steps: Cause the zone thermostat to report a boiler fault.
Open the affected zone in the app.
Review the zone alert and any available notification.
expected: The app associates the boiler fault with the correct zone and displays a clear fault status. Other zones are not incorrectly marked as faulty.

title: Reject an invitation with an invalid email
preconditions: The owner is signed in to the iOS app and has a home with an available member place.
steps: Open household sharing and choose to invite a member.
Enter an invalid email address.
Try to send the invitation.
expected: The app does not send an invitation and clearly identifies the email address as invalid.

title: Enforce the password rules during sign-up
preconditions: The iOS app is open on the account creation screen and the password rules are visible or accessible.
steps: Enter valid values in the non-password fields.
Enter a password that does not meet one displayed rule.
Submit the form.
expected: The app explains which password requirement is unmet and does not create the account.

title: Check temperature reading at lower display limit
preconditions: The thermostat is powered and its temperature sensor is connected. The room is within the sensor's supported operating range.
steps: Wake the thermostat display.
Read the room temperature when the room is cold.
Check that the display remains responsive.
expected: The thermostat shows a numeric temperature and does not replace it with a blank value or unrelated error.

title: Check missed Wi-Fi network error
preconditions: The thermostat is powered on and paired. A controlled method is available to make its configured Wi-Fi network unavailable.
steps: Make the configured Wi-Fi network unavailable.
Observe the thermostat display.
expected: The thermostat displays E-101 to indicate that the Wi-Fi network cannot be found. The display remains usable for local heating controls.

title: Verify display with a language change
preconditions: A supported language other than the current display language is available. Thermostat is idle on its home screen.
steps: Open the language setting using the thermostat controls.
Select another supported language.
Inspect the home screen and a menu or status message.
Restore the original language.
expected: All displayed labels and messages change to the selected language without clipping or garbled characters. Restoring the original language returns the display text to its previous form.

title: Check readings after a long idle period
preconditions: The thermostat is powered and showing sensor readings. It can remain untouched for at least 30 minutes before the test begins.
steps: Wake the display without opening a settings menu.
Read the temperature and humidity values.
Wait five minutes and read them again.
Check that the display remains responsive.
expected: Both sensor readings are present when the display is checked after the idle period. Values refresh normally and the display responds to the dial.

title: Show clear status when app is reopened
preconditions: A firmware update is pending or in progress. The Android app is signed in to the home.
steps: Open the firmware status screen.
Close the app completely.
Reopen the app and return to the same thermostat.
expected: The app shows the latest available update status rather than stale progress. It does not restart or cancel the update merely because the app was closed.

title: Open a notification detail
preconditions: A user account is signed in and at least one notification is available. The notification has a details view or linked destination.
steps: Open the notifications view.
Select a notification.
expected: The selected notification opens its details or destination. The displayed information matches the selected notification.

title: Reject an already registered email
preconditions: An account already exists for the email address to be used. The tester is signed out and on the registration page.
steps: Enter the existing email address and a valid password.
Submit the registration form.
Review the displayed response.
expected: Registration is not completed. The dashboard displays a clear message that the email cannot be used, without exposing another account's private details.

title: Handle cloud access being unavailable
preconditions: The thermostat is powered and can join a 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi network, but the Dormouse cloud is unreachable during pairing.
steps: Start pairing and select the available network.
Enter valid network credentials and submit them.
Wait for the pairing result and observe the display.
expected: The thermostat does not show pairing as complete while the cloud is unreachable. It displays E-110 and provides a clear way to retry or leave the flow.

title: Show failed firmware update error
preconditions: The test environment can make a firmware update fail and the thermostat is paired with the iOS app. The thermostat has stable power and Wi-Fi unless the failure under test requires otherwise.
steps: Trigger a failed firmware update in the test environment.
Open the thermostat status in the iOS app.
Check the thermostat display and app guidance.
expected: The thermostat displays E-510 and the app reports that the firmware update failed. The app does not claim the new firmware is installed and provides a clear next step or retry status.

title: Edit schedules for the correct zone
preconditions: An owner is signed in to a home with two paired thermostats in separate zones, each with a distinct schedule.
steps: Open the first zone and change one period.
Save the change.
Open the second zone and review its schedule.
expected: The change is applied only to the first zone. The second zone's schedule remains unchanged.

title: Expire an idle session securely
preconditions: The dashboard's documented idle-session timeout is known. The tester is signed in.
steps: Leave the dashboard idle for the documented timeout period.
Attempt to open an account page.
Try to submit an account change if the page remains visible.
expected: The expired session requires authentication before private data or account changes can be accessed. Any unsaved action is not silently applied.

title: Lower the target below room temperature
preconditions: The thermostat is online and the room temperature is above 18 degrees. The dashboard can control the thermostat.
steps: Open the zone's heating controls.
Set the target to 18 degrees.
Save the change.
Check the boiler status.
expected: The target is shown as 18 degrees on the dashboard and thermostat. The boiler is not requested to heat while the measured temperature is above the target.

title: Check schedule with boiler not responding
preconditions: A schedule is saved with a period whose target is above the measured room temperature. The boiler can be made unresponsive safely for the test.
steps: Make the boiler unavailable to the thermostat.
Wait for the scheduled period to become active or set a near-future start time.
Check the thermostat display and error code.
Restore the boiler and check the schedule again.
expected: The schedule remains saved and active as configured. The thermostat reports E-305 when the boiler does not respond, then retains the schedule after boiler service returns.

title: Use a recovery option for two-step verification
preconditions: A verified account has two-step verification enabled and a supported recovery option is configured and accessible to the tester.
steps: Sign in with the correct email and password.
Choose the available recovery option instead of entering a code.
Complete the recovery verification.
expected: The app verifies the recovery method and grants access only after successful verification.

title: Check frost protection setting
preconditions: The thermostat is online and the iOS app is signed in. Frost protection is available for the selected thermostat.
steps: Open the heating settings in the iOS app.
Select frost protection.
Check the target shown in the app and on the thermostat.
expected: Frost protection sets the target to 5 degrees and the app and thermostat show the same setting.

title: Update after pairing timeout
preconditions: The thermostat is not paired to Wi-Fi and can be made to show E-104. An update check is available from its controls.
steps: Confirm E-104 is shown or reproduce the pairing timeout.
Attempt to check for a firmware update from the thermostat.
Read the resulting message and return to the home screen.
expected: The thermostat clearly indicates that an internet connection is required for the update. It does not imply that an update has been downloaded or installed.

title: Check display refresh with slow sensor changes
preconditions: The thermostat is powered and displaying sensor readings. A safe, slowly changing room condition is available.
steps: Observe the displayed temperature and humidity for one minute.
Make a small, gradual change to the room conditions.
Watch the display for updates over the next five minutes.
Check that both values remain legible between updates.
expected: Sensor values refresh without the screen flashing, leaving stale digits, or temporarily displaying garbled characters. Both values remain legible.

title: Restore location permission for geofencing
preconditions: Geofencing is configured but location permission has been denied in Android settings.
steps: Grant the required location permission in Android settings.
Return to the Dormouse app.
Check geofencing status.
expected: The app recognises the restored permission and allows geofencing to operate. It does not silently change the saved away mode settings.

title: Check account form labels with a screen reader
preconditions: A supported screen reader is enabled and the web dashboard account form is open.
steps: Navigate through the form fields with screen-reader commands.
Listen to each field's name, purpose, and required status.
Trigger a validation error and navigate to its message.
expected: Each control has an announced, meaningful label and required state. Validation errors are associated with the relevant fields and are announced clearly.

title: Check sensor readings after a gentle housing clean
preconditions: The thermostat is powered and displaying live readings. A dry, soft cloth is available; no liquid or cleaning spray will be used.
steps: Record the displayed temperature and humidity.
Gently wipe the exterior housing with the dry cloth without pressing on sensor openings.
Check that both readings remain available.
expected: The display and both readings remain functional after cleaning, with no sensor fault or blank reading.

title: Check account pages at browser zoom
preconditions: The web dashboard sign-in page is open in a desktop browser.
steps: Set browser zoom to 200 percent.
Navigate through the sign-in and account help links.
Check text, controls, and validation messages.
expected: Account content remains readable and usable at 200 percent zoom. Controls and messages are not clipped or overlapped, and horizontal scrolling is not required for ordinary form use.

title: Sign in with valid credentials
preconditions: A verified Dormouse account exists and the tester knows its correct email address and password. The tester is signed out.
steps: Open the sign-in form.
Enter the account email address and password.
Submit the form and complete any requested verification.
expected: The tester is signed in to the correct account. The app does not ask for account creation.

title: Check temperature reading at upper display limit
preconditions: The thermostat is powered and its temperature sensor is connected. The room is within the sensor's supported operating range.
steps: Wake the thermostat display.
Read the room temperature when the room is warm.
Check that the display remains responsive.
expected: The thermostat shows a numeric temperature and does not replace it with a blank value or unrelated error.

title: Mark all notifications as read
preconditions: A user account is signed in and has at least two unread notifications.
steps: Open the notifications view.
Choose the option to mark all notifications as read.
Refresh the view.
expected: All previously unread notifications are shown as read. No notification is deleted.

title: Verify display after returning from a menu
preconditions: The thermostat is on its home screen and its menu can be opened using the dial.
steps: Open a menu using the normal dial interaction.
Navigate to a different screen without changing a setting.
Return to the home screen.
expected: The home screen is restored with current readings and controls, without stale menu text or duplicated screen elements.

title: Add the sixth daily schedule period
preconditions: The iOS app is signed in with permission to manage schedules. A zone has five schedule periods on the selected day.
steps: Open that zone's schedule for the selected day.
Add a sixth period with a valid time and temperature.
Save and reopen the schedule.
expected: The sixth period is saved and shown in the schedule.

title: Verify screen shows active away status
preconditions: Away mode is enabled and the thermostat is in an away state according to the configured geofence.
steps: Observe the home screen while away mode is active.
Check the status label or icon for away mode.
Return within the configured geofence or otherwise end away mode.
expected: The display clearly distinguishes active away mode from normal heating operation and updates the status when away mode ends.

title: Reach the eight-member limit
preconditions: The owner is signed in and the home already has eight members, not counting the owner. The owner can attempt another invitation.
steps: Open household sharing settings.
Enter a valid email address for a new invitee.
Try to send the invitation.
expected: The dashboard prevents an additional invitation and explains the member limit. No invitation is sent and the household remains within the limit.

title: Pair using an iOS Wi-Fi password saved in Keychain
preconditions: The iPhone is connected to a working 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi network whose password is saved in iOS. The thermostat is in pairing mode, and the signed-in account can add a thermostat.
steps: Start adding a thermostat in the iOS app.
Select the saved Wi-Fi network and use the iOS password autofill suggestion.
Confirm the password and continue through pairing.
expected: The app accepts the autofilled password and completes pairing. The thermostat appears in the account and reports a successful connection.

title: Verify a member can view the schedule
preconditions: A home has an owner and a household member account. The member is signed in to the web dashboard and has access to the home's zone.
steps: Open the zone's schedule as the member.
Review the schedule for the current day.
Navigate between another day's schedule and the current day.
expected: The member can view the schedules for zones they can access. Schedule details are shown accurately and the member is not shown another home's schedule.

title: Delete a zone with confirmation
preconditions: An owner is signed in to the web dashboard. A zone with an assigned thermostat exists.
steps: Choose to delete the zone.
Cancel the confirmation prompt and verify the zone remains.
Choose delete again and confirm.
expected: Cancelling leaves the zone and assignment unchanged. Confirming deletes the zone, and the thermostat remains registered to the home but is no longer assigned to that zone.

title: Set a zone target to the highest temperature
preconditions: A zone with an online thermostat exists. The Android app is signed in to the home.
steps: Open the zone's heating controls.
Set the target temperature to 30 degrees.
Check the app display and the thermostat display.
expected: Both displays show a target of 30 degrees. The app accepts the highest supported target without changing it.

title: Save a half-degree target temperature
preconditions: An owner is signed in and has an online thermostat with a configured zone.
steps: Open a schedule period for editing.
Set its target to 19.5 degrees.
Save and reopen the period.
expected: The period displays and retains a target of 19.5 degrees. The value is not rounded to a whole degree.

title: Check heating demand when room is below target
preconditions: The thermostat is powered on, the boiler is responsive, and the room temperature is below the selected target. Heating is not in frost protection.
steps: Set a target above the displayed room temperature.
Confirm the target.
Observe the heating status on the display.
expected: The thermostat indicates a demand for heat and sends a heating request to the boiler.

title: Reject an expired verification code
preconditions: A verified account has two-step verification enabled, and the tester can obtain a code and wait for it to expire.
steps: Sign in with the correct email and password.
Obtain a verification code and wait until it expires.
Enter the expired code and submit it.
expected: The app rejects the expired code and indicates that a current code is needed.

title: Avoid duplicate thermostat after repeated submission
preconditions: The app is signed in and the thermostat is in pairing mode. A 2.4 GHz network is available and has valid credentials.
steps: Start pairing and submit valid network details.
Tap the submit or continue control repeatedly while it is processing.
Wait for pairing to finish and inspect the device list.
expected: The app prevents duplicate submissions or safely handles them. Exactly one thermostat entry is created and it shows online.

title: Check sensor readings when boiler reports a fault
preconditions: The thermostat is powered and displaying live readings. A safe test setup can make the boiler report a fault without creating a hazard.
steps: Record the displayed temperature and humidity.
Cause the boiler to report a fault using the approved test procedure.
Check the thermostat display and return to its sensor view if needed.
expected: The thermostat indicates E-312 for the boiler fault, and the temperature and humidity readings remain available when the sensor view is shown.

title: View readings for each zone
preconditions: An owner is signed in to the web dashboard. Two zones each contain an online thermostat with different temperature and humidity readings.
steps: Open the zones overview.
Compare the temperature and humidity shown for both zones.
Open each zone's details.
expected: Each zone shows readings from its own assigned thermostat. Readings are not incorrectly attributed to the other zone.

title: Enable frost protection at 5 degrees
preconditions: The thermostat is paired and online. The Android app is signed in and shows frost protection controls.
steps: Open heating controls.
Enable frost protection.
Check the target shown in the app and on the thermostat.
expected: Frost protection is active with a 5-degree target. The app and thermostat show matching status.

title: Cancel adding a schedule period
preconditions: The selected day has fewer than six periods. The thermostat is paired and the schedule editor is available.
steps: Choose Add period.
Enter a start time and target temperature.
Cancel or exit without saving.
Review the selected day's periods.
expected: No new period is added, and the existing schedule remains unchanged.

title: Check notification after sign-out
preconditions: The iOS app has an account signed in, notifications are allowed, and a paired thermostat can generate test events. The account can be signed out in the app.
steps: Sign out of the iOS app.
Generate a test event for the signed-out account's home.
Check the iPhone notification centre.
Tap any notification received.
expected: Private home details are not displayed to a signed-out user. Any notification or tap-through requires sign-in before showing protected information.

title: Check low batteries on a zone thermostat
preconditions: A battery-powered thermostat is assigned to a zone. Safe test batteries or a supported low-battery test method are available.
steps: Apply the approved low-battery test condition.
Check the thermostat display for the battery warning.
Restore batteries to a normal level and check the display.
